zones.name: Hearthwood
zones.blurb: A wooded river valley where every mage begins.
zones.arrival: Alders lean over the water, and the whole valley smells of wet bark and woodsmoke. Someone is sharpening something. Nobody looks up when you pass, which is its own kind of welcome.

zones.name: Whispering Woods
zones.blurb: Sun-dappled woods that murmur when nothing is moving them.
zones.arrival: Sun comes down through the leaves in pieces and moves when they move. It is a good path, well walked, and the air smells of warm bark. Somewhere under it all, something is murmuring.
beats: The murmur stops the moment you stand still to listen. When you walk on, it starts again.
You have passed this bend before. The path has not looped — you have been watching for that. The trees have moved.
It is not coming from the trees. It is coming from underneath them, from the roots crossing beneath the path, and it is all one sound. You have been walking on it this whole time.
zones.epilogue: The murmur does not stop when the heartwood comes down. It moves — under the path, out toward the edges, somewhere you cannot walk to — and settles there. You did not kill anything. You interrupted something, and it noticed you doing it.

zones.name: Glimmerbrook
zones.blurb: Springs and shallows east of Hearthwood, bright enough to hurt.
zones.arrival: The brook runs over pale stones and throws the light back at you in pieces. Fish hang in the current without swimming. The water is colder than the season should allow.

zones.name: Cinderpeak Foothills
zones.blurb: The first rise north, where the ground is warm through your boots.
zones.arrival: The grass gives out and the slope turns to grey grit that shifts under you. Somewhere above, the mountain is breathing. The air tastes of struck flint.

zones.name: Thornmire
zones.blurb: Where the woods drown in the brook's outflow.
zones.arrival: The path becomes a suggestion, then a rumour, then water. Trees stand in it up to their knees and have made peace with that. Everything green here is winning.

zones.name: Ashfall Vale
zones.blurb: Downwind of the cone: the burn scar where ash falls on forest.
zones.arrival: Grey settles on every leaf until the whole valley looks like a charcoal drawing of itself. New shoots are already pushing up through it. Fire came through here, and something is arguing about whether it won.

zones.name: Pennycross
zones.gate: Three ordinary proofs, shown to the guard on the north road into Pennycross
zones.blurb: The first market, where the river road crosses the mountain road.
zones.arrival: Two roads meet and a town happened. Stalls have grown into buildings, and the buildings still look like stalls. Everyone is halfway through a transaction.

zones.name: Forgeholm
zones.blurb: A city with a mountain for a roof, cut into the Ironspine.
zones.arrival: You arrive at a door. The road ends at a gate in the rock and everything past it was cut rather than built — halls stacked over halls, stairs where a street would be, and a red glow a long way down that never goes out. Ore does not leave here until it has a name. It is never quiet and never cold.

zones.name: Old Quarry
zones.blurb: Cut into the range's southern flank, and cut too deep.
zones.arrival: The road stops being a road and becomes the floor of something somebody dug. Terraces step down into shadow, each one squarer than anything nature makes, and the tool marks are old. Whatever was quarried out of here left a shape, and the shape has started to move.

zones.name: Stormcliff Coast
zones.blurb: Where the western ocean's weather hits a wall and has nowhere to go.
zones.arrival: The cliffs take the whole weight of it. Spray comes up further than it should and your hair lifts before you hear the crack. The rock is scorched in long vertical lines.

zones.name: Galehaven
zones.blurb: The one notch in a hundred miles of cliff.
zones.arrival: The harbour is impossibly calm for what is happening outside it. Cloth and dye come off the boats in bales; nothing here is made locally except the ships.

zones.name: Windward Steppe
zones.blurb: A high tableland east of the crest, scoured flat.
zones.arrival: Nothing here is taller than your knee, and everything leans the same way. The wind does not gust; it simply blows, and has been blowing since before there was anyone to notice.

zones.name: Frostfell Pass
zones.blurb: The way through. Sea air lifted over the crest and frozen there.
zones.arrival: The pass is a white corridor between two black walls. Your breath goes up and does not come down. The road is under here somewhere, and other people have been sure of that too.

zones.name: Thunderspire Peaks
zones.blurb: The summit line where coastal storm meets steppe wind.
zones.arrival: You are inside the weather rather than under it. The cloud is lit from within at intervals, and the intervals are getting shorter. Metal hums.

zones.name: The Molten Deep
zones.blurb: Under the quarry, under the mountain, under the sea's level.
zones.arrival: The quarry's deepest gallery keeps going after the tool marks stop. The rock gets warm, then hot, then lit from below. There is a floor down here that moves like water because it is not water.

zones.name: Concordance
zones.gate: The Kinetic Sigil, in three parts, shown at the gate
zones.blurb: The trade capital, at the head of navigation on the River Concord.
zones.arrival: Everything that moves by water or road in this world passes through here, and the city has arranged itself around that fact. You show your Sigil at the gate. Nobody fights you; someone writes your name down.

zones.name: The Kiln Desert
zones.blurb: A cold high desert in the range's rain shadow, and the sunniest ground in the world.
zones.arrival: The air is too thin to hold heat, so the sun burns while the wind bites. There is no shade anywhere and no water for a day's walk. Your shadow is the hardest-edged thing you have ever seen.

zones.name: The Mirrormere
zones.blurb: A high still lake that holds the moon better than the sky does.
zones.arrival: Not a ripple. The surface gives you back the mountains, the stars, and the moon at a size the moon has no right to be. Walking the shore, you are careful not to look down for too long.

zones.name: Starfall Basin
zones.blurb: A crater field, preserved because nothing grows to cover it.
zones.arrival: Bowl after bowl in the pale ground, each with something at the bottom that is not from here. Nothing has grown over them because nothing grows. At night the sky is so clear it looks like a threat.

zones.name: Meridian
zones.blurb: An observatory on the crest of the Scarp: the highest dark-sky ground there is.
zones.arrival: A town of long roofs that open. Everyone keeps different hours and nobody explains. From the crest you can see the desert on one side and, on the other, a valley with no light in it at all.

zones.name: Tidewrack Shoals
zones.blurb: Tides that obey the moon exactly, on the northern shore.
zones.arrival: The water goes out further than seems survivable and comes back faster. What it uncovers has been down there a long time. Everything is timed to something overhead.

zones.name: The Sunless Reach
zones.blurb: The Scarp's north face. Direct sun never reaches the floor.
zones.arrival: You come over the crest out of glare into a valley that has never been lit. The rock is the same rock. The desert is a thousand feet away and on the other side of the world.

zones.name: The Shattered Orrery
zones.blurb: A broken model of the heavens, still trying to run.
zones.arrival: Rings the size of bridges, half of them fallen, and the fallen half still turning. The arcing is not weather; it is the mechanism. Something is being calculated and has been for a very long time.

zones.name: Rimeholt
zones.gate: A Celestial Totem charged with the Solar, Lunar and Astral essences, to pass the barrier above the town
zones.blurb: Basecamp. The last mortal outpost, above the tree line.
zones.arrival: There is no wood here, so nothing is built of it. The town is stone and rope and hide, dug in against a slope that goes up out of sight. Everyone you meet is either arriving or leaving; nobody is from here.

zones.name: Hallowmarch
zones.blurb: The Vault's south flank: a consecrated causeway up the only side that thaws.
zones.arrival: A raised road, and someone built it. The sun reaches this face for a few hours and the meltwater runs beside you the whole way. Every mile or so there is a marker, and every marker has been maintained.

zones.name: The Umbral Wastes
zones.blurb: The Vault's north face. No direct sun at any hour of any day.
zones.arrival: You round the shoulder and the light stops. Not dusk — an absence with an edge to it. The ice here has never melted and holds its shape like something that has been thought about.

zones.name: The Reliquary Deep
zones.blurb: A vault bored through the mountain, open now at the dark end.
zones.arrival: The way in is a hole in the ice on the north face, and it goes inward and downward toward a warm flank you never reach. A corridor that someone consecrated and someone else did not leave alone. It gets warmer the further you go, and the far door has been shut for longer than the order that shut it lasted.

zones.name: Vespergate
zones.blurb: Where the ground runs out. The last place with a supply line.
zones.arrival: A fortress at the top of the world, facing the wrong way — not outward at an enemy but upward, at nothing. Above it the rock goes vertical and stops being a route. They have been brewing their own everything for a long time.

zones.name: The Sealed Garden
zones.blurb: A garden nobody has been let into for a very long time.
zones.arrival: The wall is low enough to see over and that is the whole cruelty of it. Inside, everything is in leaf and in season at once. The gate is shut, the guard is still at the gate, and the faith that posted him has been gone for centuries.

zones.name: The Glass Archive
zones.blurb: They wrote it in light, and light does not keep.
zones.arrival: Lenses on every roof, and all of them still aimed. Around midday the hillside fills with writing you can almost read, and by the time your eyes adjust it has moved on. Whatever they recorded here, they recorded onto the one thing that will not hold still.

zones.name: The Buried Sky
zones.blurb: The oldest rock in the world, and it is full of stars.
zones.arrival: You climb to the top of everything in order to go down. The shaft cuts through band after band of stone, and every band holds a scatter of light in it. None of the patterns match the sky you walked in under.

zones.name: The Collapsed Academy
zones.blurb: A school that read too far, and left.
zones.arrival: It is not ruined so much as unfinished in the wrong direction. Staircases arrive at rooms that were never built. The syllabus is still on the wall and the last three items on it are not in any language you have.

zones.name: The Unwritten Library
zones.blurb: Knowledge that eats its keeper. The shelves are still filling.
zones.arrival: Every book here is being written right now, by nobody. The shelves go up past where a ceiling would be. Something is taking dictation and it would like your name for the record.

zones.name: The Eclipsed Citadel
zones.blurb: The door back into the world, and the thing standing in it.
zones.arrival: Below it, through a gap in nothing, is the summit of the mountain you could not climb. The Citadel is between you and it. That is what the name has always meant.

zones.name: Zenith
zones.station: Every station — the only town with all six
zones.gate: The Concordant Crown: twelve elemental gems and twelve Cores, bound with a purchased binding spell
zones.blurb: The summit. Visible from everywhere below, and shut.
zones.arrival: The doors were never locked from the inside. From up here the whole world is one thing, and every city you have ever walked into is a mark on it you could put a finger over.

creatures.name: Listening Fawn
creatures.lore: It does not flee and it does not approach. Twice I have looked up to find it closer without having seen it move, and both times it was facing the ground rather than me.

creatures.name: Thornback Sprite
creatures.lore: Small, and gone before the swing finishes. The thorns are not for defence — it plants them, and comes back for them later.

creatures.name: Sporecap Shambler
creatures.lore: The cap is the animal and the body is scaffolding. Cut the body and the cap simply builds another, more slowly and slightly wrong.

creatures.name: Bindweed Creeper
creatures.lore: It drinks. Everything in this wood that stands still long enough is eventually part of the same drink, and it is patient about it.

creatures.name: Rootknuckle
creatures.lore: A knot of root that comes up through the path where the path is thinnest. It is not hunting. You are simply standing on it.

creatures.name: Elderroot
creatures.lore: Older than the path, and the path was surveyed twice. It has been doing this longer than anything else here and it shows.

creatures.name: Mother Spore
creatures.lore: Every shambler in the wood is hers, and she does not appear to care about any of them individually.

creatures.name: Hollow Stag
creatures.lore: What is left of a Listening Fawn that listened for long enough. It is still facing the ground.

creatures.name: The Murmur
creatures.lore: The sound the whole wood makes, standing in one place for once. It knows the shape of what you were about to do.

creatures.name: Heartwood
creatures.lore: Everything under the path runs back to here. Standing at its base, the murmur is not a sound any more; it is a pressure.

creatures.name: The Standing Green
creatures.lore: The wood grew this in the shape of a person, and got the proportions nearly right. It is the "nearly" that stays with you.

creatures.name: Brook Naiad
creatures.lore: A child-sized figure of clear water with pale stones hanging inside it where organs should be. Its edge is sharp, not misty, which is the detail that stops it looking like weather.

creatures.name: Shiverfish Shoal
creatures.lore: Forty fish holding one shape, too rigidly to be natural. It casts a single shadow, and I have not yet seen a fish leave it.

creatures.name: Glassfleck Wisp
creatures.lore: Made of the light off the water rather than of the water. It throws the brightness back at you in pieces, and looks as though touching it would end the argument.

creatures.name: Siltback Crawler
creatures.lore: A crayfish crossed with a boulder, low to the riverbed and crusted over with weed. Two eyes on stalks, set close, and both of them on you the whole time.

creatures.name: Chill Eel
creatures.lore: Bone-white and nearly clear, held straight rather than coiled. Frost forms on the water around it while it is doing nothing whatsoever.

creatures.name: Weirkeeper
creatures.lore: A man built out of the beams of an old weir, wet timber and river stone, water pouring steadily through the gaps in its chest. It carries nothing, because it does not need to.

creatures.name: The Held Breath
creatures.lore: One bubble of air taller than a man, held under and refusing to rise. There is a curled shape inside it. I have written down twice that it is a thing being kept, not a thing swimming.

creatures.name: Pale Coil
creatures.lore: An eel as thick as a man's waist and three times his length, coiled once with the head up. Blind. The water around it is noticeably clearer than the rest, which I would rather not think about.

creatures.name: Frostgleam Naiad
creatures.lore: A Brook Naiad grown up and half frozen — ice blooming across her shoulders and brow while the rest of her still runs. She is not in any hurry, and the stones inside her have stopped moving.

creatures.name: The Cold Below
creatures.lore: Broad, flat and wider than a house, seen through water that should not be deep enough to hold it. Only part of it is ever visible. The rest goes down into black and keeps going.

creatures.name: Stillwater
creatures.lore: Three storeys of standing pool, mirror-flat on every face, with no features of any kind. It reflects whoever is in front of it. Nothing inside it moves, and that is the entire horror of the thing.

creatures.name: Ashjaw Brute
creatures.lore: Ox-sized, and caked in grey ash that has dried and cracked like a riverbed. There is orange light in the cracks. It stands square and keeps its head low, which is not deference.

creatures.name: Flint Skink
creatures.lore: Forearm-length, and its scales are knapped flint — faceted, dark, and glowing orange between the plates. It crosses rock too hot to stand on and does not appear to notice.

creatures.name: Cinder Moth
creatures.lore: Two hands across, wings a translucent ash-grey shot through with ember veins that brighten toward the body. It looks one touch from disintegrating, and that turns out to be accurate.

creatures.name: Slagshell Tortoise
creatures.lore: The shell is one lump of cooled lava, pitted and cracked with dull red still down in the fissures. The face underneath it is ancient and entirely patient. It draws in slightly and waits you out.

creatures.name: Ventworm
creatures.lore: Half out of a fissure and as long as a man, dull red-brown and segmented. Its front end is a ring of small plates rather than a mouth, and sulphur comes out of it steadily whether or not it moves.

creatures.name: Slagheart
creatures.lore: A man-shape of cooled black lava, cracked throughout, with one fist-sized cavity in the chest and a molten core sitting in it. The arms do not match. It moves deliberately and it is balanced.

creatures.name: Vent Warden
creatures.lore: Twice as wide as a man and barely taller, fused slag and black basalt, with its legs sunk into the rock over a fissure. Its whole chest is a grate glowing deep orange. There is no head; the shoulders simply end.

creatures.name: Char-Tusk
creatures.lore: A boar shoulder-high to a man, hide burnt black and split with glowing seams, two great upward tusks of cracked stone with the tips still hot. It puts one foreleg forward and then does not move again.

creatures.name: The Emberqueen
creatures.lore: A moth the size of a large dog, wings a deep smouldering red held wide and scorched into a pattern I could not copy accurately. She displays rather than beats them. She has not once tried to leave.

creatures.name: The Breathing Stone
creatures.lore: Four storeys of grey rock and scree in the rough shape of something hunched. The fissures down its back widen and narrow, slowly, in time. Vapour comes off its shoulders. It is the mountain, and the mountain is what has been breathing.

creatures.name: Flintmaw
creatures.lore: A great cat rendered in fractured volcanic glass, horse-sized and low, every plane sharp and faintly reflective with molten orange in the seams between. The jaw is too long. It watches, and it waits, and it is clearly deciding something.

creatures.name: Mirewalker
creatures.lore: Tall, thin and long in the limb, black waterlogged wood hung with weed, wading upright. Bog water runs out of its joints the whole time. Its head is a narrow bud with nothing on it.

creatures.name: Thirstvine
creatures.lore: Coiled like a python and swollen tight with what it has taken. Where it has fed the vine is fat and bright; where it has not, it is thin and grey. You can read its week off it.

creatures.name: Leechcap
creatures.lore: A plate-sized mushroom of wet dark red travelling gill-side down on a fringe of pale feelers. The underside spirals in to a small dark opening. Water runs off the cap and never into it.

creatures.name: Bog Lantern
creatures.lore: A seed-head the size of a man's head floating at chest height, lit greenish-white from inside, trailing a crown of fine filaments. The light is warm. The thing itself is not.

creatures.name: Reedback Lurker
creatures.lore: Boat-sized, half submerged, its back a plate of green-black shell so overgrown with living reed that it reads as a piece of the bank. Two small dark eyes at the waterline. I walked past it twice.

creatures.name: Old Wallow
creatures.lore: Cart-sized, low and broad like a hippopotamus, and so thoroughly overgrown with moss and ferns and small saplings that the animal is a rumour under a garden. Small eyes, set high. Half out of the water.

creatures.name: The Green Drowning
creatures.lore: A standing wall of matted weed and root three times a man's height and as wide, rising sheer out of the bog with water pouring off it without stopping. No limbs. No face. It advances.

creatures.name: Wickerdrowned
creatures.lore: A man-shape woven out of wet withies, hollow all the way through, with black water sloshing audibly inside the ribs. The arms have been sharpened. The head is a woven cage, tilted, listening.

creatures.name: Fenmother
creatures.lore: Hunched and broad-hipped, twice a man's bulk, woven reed over black mud and standing waist-deep. Her arms are long bundles of dripping root. Where a face should be there is a mat of green weed, hanging.

creatures.name: Mirethroat
creatures.lore: A ring of dark muscular plant matter wider than a house, lying level with the bog and opening into a funnel lined with rows of soft inward-pointing spines. The water spirals into it, slowly, always.

creatures.name: The Drinking Grove
creatures.lore: Six drowned trees that have grown into one four-storey creature, trunks fused and canopy shared. Its roots are lifted clear of the water and end in a thicket of pale swollen tendrils, all dripping. The high branches are in full leaf and perfectly healthy.

creatures.name: Cinderbloom Husk
creatures.lore: A burnt stalk the height of a man, hollow and brittle, topped with a charred seed head that sheds grey without stopping. Green shoots have already broken through the black stem. It walks on stiff roots.

creatures.name: Ashroot Sapling
creatures.lore: No taller than a man, bark scorched black down one side and pale green down the other, walking on a splay of roots. The roots are visibly drawing ash up into the trunk, and the green side is the better for it.

creatures.name: Emberseed
creatures.lore: A melon-sized pod hovering a hand above the ground, husk cracked open in a spiral around a fiercely glowing core. Charred filaments trail behind it. Everything about it reads as about to burst.

creatures.name: Scorchmoth
creatures.lore: Hand-sized and narrow in the wing, sooty black with tiny bright green spots across it like new leaves. Thin body, long legs, and it does not hold still long enough to be counted. Ash falls around it constantly.

creatures.name: Charwood Walker
creatures.lore: A dead tree twice a man's height, charred and stripped, walking on two thick root-legs with branches for arms. Dull orange heat still sits in the cracks. One green branch grows from a shoulder, and it has not been shed.

creatures.name: The Grey Stag
creatures.lore: A tall stag the colour of cold ash, coat gone uniform grey, antlers burnt black at the tips. Small green leaves are growing from the base of the antlers. It raises its head and it does not run.

creatures.name: First Green
creatures.lore: A thicket of new growth risen into a squat figure twice a man's width, every surface crowded with bright young leaves. Underneath the green there are glimpses of blackened wood. It is rooted, and it does not intend to move.

creatures.name: Last Ember
creatures.lore: Man-height and thin as a whip, charcoal and living flame, trailing sparks it does not seem to miss. Cracked black over white heat all the way down. There is nothing green on it anywhere.

creatures.name: Kindleroot
creatures.lore: A cart-wide sprawl of root lifted up off the ground, every tip glowing orange like a slow match. Wherever it has crossed there are small fires and small shoots, both, in the same tracks. It has no head at all.

creatures.name: The Blackened Crown
creatures.lore: Four storeys of burnt heartwood in roughly the shape of a man, broad in the shoulder, upright, still. The head is ringed with charred branches burning steadily and white. Nothing grows on it. It looks like it won.

creatures.name: The Rooting
creatures.lore: A mound of new growth four storeys across and only two high, made of thousands of young saplings and ferns and vines grown together. Burnt timber and old bones are visible inside it, being swallowed. It looks like it is winning.

creatures.name: Quarry Golem
creatures.lore: Stacked terrace stone that never settled after it was cut, holding roughly the shape of what used to stand there. It moves like something remembering how to walk.

creatures.name: Tailings Drudge
creatures.lore: Loose spoil piled by hands that stopped caring where it went, shuffling in slow circles because nobody ever told it the digging was over.

creatures.name: Chiselback
creatures.lore: Fist-sized and quick, its shell scored with the same parallel grooves a chisel leaves in a cut face. It moves before the tool marks finish settling.

creatures.name: Gravelswarm
creatures.lore: Not one thing but hundreds of loose stones holding a single shape between them, shifting and re-forming with every stride like scree that decided to walk uphill.

creatures.name: Plumbline Sentry
creatures.lore: A slab hung dead vertical on nothing, exactly the way a mason's plumbline hangs, and it does not lean no matter what strikes it.

creatures.name: Obsidian Golem
creatures.lore: Black glass where the quarry face sheared clean, taller than a man and balanced without effort, both fists a different size because nothing made them match.

creatures.name: Earth Titan
creatures.lore: Three terraces' worth of stone gathered into one standing weight, planted wherever it stops as if the ground had always meant to be that shape.

creatures.name: Deadweight
creatures.lore: A slab shaped for hauling, still moving the way something on a sledge moves — slow, then all at once, and it does not stop where a person would.

creatures.name: The Overseer
creatures.lore: Wears the old measuring marks cut into the rock as though they were its own joints, and it corrects anything that has drifted out of true, including itself.

creatures.name: Mountain Heart
creatures.lore: The mass the quarry gave up, wearing its own crater like a chest cavity. Whatever was carried out of this mountain, it remembers carrying it.

creatures.name: The Empty Course
creatures.lore: A hollow the exact shape of what is missing, walking upright because the missing thing once did. It has no face, only the place a face was cut from.

creatures.name: Steppe Harrier
creatures.lore: Wings held stiff and angled, it does not flap so much as let the wind carry it low over the grass, correcting by inches. It strikes from the same glide it was already holding.

creatures.name: Leanstone
creatures.lore: A standing stone worn to a permanent lean, the windward face smoothed to nothing and the leeward face still sharp. It has not moved in longer than anyone has been counting, and it is not going to start for you.

creatures.name: Chaff
creatures.lore: Threshed stalk and seed husk, blown into a moving mass that holds its shape only because the wind keeps refilling it from behind. It stings in passing and is already somewhere else.

creatures.name: Tumblehusk
creatures.lore: A hollow dried-out husk of something that used to root, rolling end over end because it stopped holding on. It only ever hits you by having been in the way.

creatures.name: Kitewing
creatures.lore: A membrane of wing stretched over hollow bone, kite-shaped and paper-thin, held up entirely by the wind it flies in. It looks one gust from tearing, which is also how it kills you.

creatures.name: Old Lean
creatures.lore: The oldest lean on the steppe, grown into something like a person-shape out of wind-scoured rock and root. Everything else here gave way a long time ago. This did not.

creatures.name: Sky Titan
creatures.lore: A standing column of wind compressed hard enough to hold a shape, roughly a person twice over. Take a piece off it and the wind behind simply fills the gap.

creatures.name: Gale Serpent
creatures.lore: A rope of visibly moving air, coiled tight before it strikes and sinuous the rest of the time. It has no body to speak of, only the shape the wind is currently making.

creatures.name: Wind Wraith
creatures.lore: A shape the wind makes and unmakes without ever quite finishing it, always at the edge of where you are looking. It has never once been seen arriving.

creatures.name: The Unbroken Blow
creatures.lore: Not a shape so much as a direction, huge and featureless and entirely without hurry. It has been blowing across this exact stretch of ground longer than the ground has been ground, and it shows no sign of having noticed you.

creatures.name: Tempest Monarch
creatures.lore: Regal only in that it holds a shape at all — a single decided gust standing apart from the wind that made it, watching, in no hurry to spend what it is clearly saving.

creatures.name: Stormcliff Tidecaller
creatures.lore: A tall, narrow figure of wet black rock standing where the spray lands hardest, hairline cracks of white light running down its front like the cliff behind it. It does not so much move as arrive, a half-second after the flash.

creatures.name: Fulgurite Crawler
creatures.lore: Knee-high and many-legged, its whole carapace fused glass, dark and faintly branching like a root system frozen mid-growth. It picks across broken rock without a single wasted step and draws in tight the moment the air starts to hum.

creatures.name: Sparkwing
creatures.lore: A hand-span of translucent wing over a body no bigger than a knuckle, riding the up-draught off the cliff face. A line of white light runs the length of each wing vein and brightens just before it lets go of the air entirely.

creatures.name: Static Shoal
creatures.lore: A loose drift of finger-length eels, pale and nearly transparent, moving as one shape in the wash at the cliff's foot. Touch any part of the shoal and the whole thing answers at once.

creatures.name: Groundling
creatures.lore: Low, quick and close to the rock, a shape like a lizard cast in wet slate. It crosses open ground in short bursts timed to the flash, never caught mid-stride when the light comes back down.

creatures.name: Brinecharge
creatures.lore: Man-tall and built like a breaking wave that never finished breaking, a churn of white water and standing light. It comes on at an even pace across open rock, balanced, entirely unhurried.

creatures.name: The Long Line
creatures.lore: A single unbroken run of white light down a wet gully wall, wide as a road and taller than a man, never quite going dark between flashes. There is no head, no front — only more of it, further up.

creatures.name: Voltgeist
creatures.lore: A standing shape of pure white afterimage, roughly a man's size and gone before the eye settles on it, only to be standing exactly where it was a moment later. It puts everything into the one blow it is clearly building toward.

creatures.name: Storm Shaman
creatures.lore: A stooped, robed shape at the very edge of the cliff, arms raised to a sky that is already answering. Wet rock, wet cloth, and a crown of small floating sparks that never quite go out.

creatures.name: Storm Lord
creatures.lore: A vast standing figure built entirely of falling and rising light, never the same shape twice and never less than man-height at the shoulder. It watches the whole cliff at once and answers whatever it decides is a threat first.

creatures.name: The Return Stroke
creatures.lore: Not a body at all — a standing column of light the width of a man, rooted in the scorched rock and reaching up out of sight into the weather. It does not move to attack. The whole coast is already wired to it, and the strike simply arrives.

creatures.name: Rime Stalker
creatures.lore: A tall, frost-whitened figure that walks the road at an even pace, never hurrying and never stopping, the way someone certain of the route walks it. Its breath hangs in the air a beat longer than anyone else's would.

creatures.name: Hoarbound
creatures.lore: A heavy shape bound in white rime from the ground up, thicker each season it stands here, until the frost is doing as much of the holding as the creature underneath it.

creatures.name: Breathfrost
creatures.lore: A visible held breath, person-sized, that never quite disperses. It rises the way breath does in the cold and simply never comes back down, thinning at the edges into wing shapes that beat once in a while, out of habit more than need.

creatures.name: Cairnwight
creatures.lore: A standing pile of trail-stones with just enough shape to be a person, added to by everyone who passed and did not make it the rest of the way. It never stops being added to.

creatures.name: Snowblind Wanderer
creatures.lore: A muffled shape that walks in a shallow curve rather than a straight line, wrapped past recognizing, following a road it can no longer see and has stopped trying to.

creatures.name: The Last Cairn
creatures.lore: Taller than the trail-markers it grew from, stones bound together with ice instead of intent, still gaining height the way the smaller ones do. Nobody added the top of it on purpose.

creatures.name: Hoarking
creatures.lore: A crowned shape of packed rime, seated rather than standing, that has been in the same drift long enough for the drift to have stopped moving around it instead.

creatures.name: Coldsnap
creatures.lore: The temperature dropping fast enough to notice, given a shape just long enough to close the distance. It is gone again before the cold it left behind finishes registering.

creatures.name: The Certain Road
creatures.lore: A low, worn track visible only when the light is wrong, that a traveler will swear they remember walking before. It has never once been wrong about where it leads.

creatures.name: The White Corridor
creatures.lore: A wall of packed white that fills the whole cut from side to side, as tall as the pass itself and moving at the speed the pass accumulates snow — which is to say, always, and without hurrying.

creatures.name: The Road Under
creatures.lore: Not a body — the road itself, still exactly where it was laid, simply no longer on top. Everything that has ever tried to cross it is somewhere in the layers between here and the surface.

creatures.name: Stormcrest Roc
creatures.lore: A roc the size of a cart, wings storm-grey and ragged at the tips, riding the up-draft off the ridge without a single wingbeat wasted. It reads the cloud the way a sailor reads water and is always somewhere above the next flash before it happens.

creatures.name: Humming Ore
creatures.lore: An outcrop of rust-veined rock that should be silent and is not — a low, steady hum runs through it that you feel in the teeth before you hear it. It does not move to defend itself. It has never needed to.

creatures.name: Flashcount
creatures.lore: A loose cluster of finger-length white filaments that arc between the rocks in a rapid, uneven stutter, never resting on one point twice in a row. It is not aiming. It is counting.

creatures.name: Updraft Wisp
creatures.lore: A hand-span knot of pale down and static, riding a thermal with no weight to speak of. It rides the same rising air the cloud does, and it goes wherever the air decides, which is occasionally through you.

creatures.name: Ionwake
creatures.lore: A compact, upright shape of charged wind and standing light, no taller than a person, moving with an even, deliberate gait against gusts that would stagger anything less certain of its footing. It trails a thin visible wake of disturbed air.

creatures.name: Crown Fire
creatures.lore: A crackling halo of white-blue light that has settled on the highest point of a ridge and stayed, bright enough to read a map by, competent at everything a storm can do. It does not build to anything — it is simply always ready.

creatures.name: Anvilhead
creatures.lore: A squat mass of storm-scarred stone shaped, almost too neatly, like an anvil — every strike the peak has taken for a hundred years seems to have found it and it has never once cracked. Wind piles up against it and goes nowhere.

creatures.name: Thunder Roc
creatures.lore: A leaner, faster roc than the ridge-riders below, feathers dark and faintly branching with trapped white light down every barb. It circles once, high, and then there is no interval left at all before it stoops.

creatures.name: The Shortening
creatures.lore: Not a body — an interval. A gap between flashes that keeps counting itself down, marked by a low floating knot of white sparks that brightens a fraction more each time the cloud lights. There is always less of it left than there was.

creatures.name: The Storm That Passes
creatures.lore: A vast standing front of cloud and charged wind, three storeys of it, moving through the peaks at a slow, indifferent walking pace that nothing here has ever managed to turn aside. It was moving before you arrived and it will still be moving after.

creatures.name: The Strike That Lands
creatures.lore: Not yet a shape — a brightening. The cloud overhead has stopped flickering and started to hold its light a little longer each time, building toward a single column that has not come down yet. When it does, there will be nothing left to count.

creatures.name: Molten Warden
creatures.lore: A standing plate of crust gone thick enough to hold its shape, hinged at nothing, planted over whatever is moving underneath it. It does not attack so much as refuse to be somewhere else.

creatures.name: Slagswimmer
creatures.lore: A long low body that moves through rock the way an eel moves through water, parting stone that is only pretending to be solid and closing again behind it, unhurried.

creatures.name: Crustwalker
creatures.lore: Something the size and shape of a boulder, walking on legs it grew for the occasion, its underside always a shade darker than the top — the part that has not finished cooling yet.

creatures.name: Ember Vent
creatures.lore: A split in the floor no wider than a hand, breathing heat in slow irregular pulses. It has no body to speak of — only the vent, and what comes out of it.

creatures.name: Cooling Thing
creatures.lore: A slick black skin over something that used to move, gone still long enough to hold an edge. Everything else down here is still liquid; this is what liquid looks like once it loses the argument.

creatures.name: The Floor
creatures.lore: Not a creature standing on the floor — the floor itself, for as far as the light reaches, moving the way water moves when nobody is watching it closely enough to call it solid.

creatures.name: Magma Behemoth
creatures.lore: A mass the size of a house, moving at the speed a house should move, its whole hide a slow tide of black crust cracking open on bright orange and closing over it again a step later.

creatures.name: Pyroclast
creatures.lore: A tight, fast-moving knot of molten rock thrown clear of whatever is boiling below, still airborne more often than not. It does not so much attack as arrive, all at once.

creatures.name: Firstmelt
creatures.lore: The first place the floor gave way, still soft at the centre long after everything around it set. It knows exactly where every other weak point is, because it used to be one.

creatures.name: The Slow Stone
creatures.lore: The one part of the floor that never joined the rest, holding its shape long after everything around it went liquid. It has had a very long time to decide it is not going to be told otherwise.

creatures.name: Efreet
creatures.lore: A shape that holds itself upright out of pure insistence, fire wearing the idea of a body rather than needing one. It has opinions about who is allowed down here, and it is standing on all of them.

creatures.name: Mirror Wraith
creatures.lore: A standing figure of lake-light with your own build and your own way of holding still, close enough that people stop walking to check. It never copies badly, and it never copies late.

creatures.name: Stillface
creatures.lore: A flat oval of unbroken water held upright at head height, showing whoever is nearest at perfect rest however hard they are moving. Nobody has reported one letting go of a reflection afterwards.

creatures.name: Undershine
creatures.lore: A moving brightness a hand's depth under the water, person-long and thinner than a person, travelling without disturbing the surface it travels beneath. It goes out all at once or not at all.

creatures.name: Ripplecut
creatures.lore: A single travelling line on an otherwise flat lake, arm-long, that reaches the far shore faster than the water it is crossing could carry it. The ripple arrives after the thing has already gone.

creatures.name: Palefish Shoal
creatures.lore: Several hundred colourless fish the length of a finger, holding one loose shoal-shape about the size of a person just under the surface. They all turn at once, and the turn is what you feel.

creatures.name: The Second You
creatures.lore: Your own shape walked up out of the shallows at your own height, dripping and entirely opaque, carrying what you are carrying. It has stopped waiting for you to move first.

creatures.name: Herald of the Waxing
creatures.lore: A broad kneeling figure of pale stone at the waterline, one side of it finished and the other still rough, and the finished side is further round every time anyone comes back to look.

creatures.name: Stalker of the New Moon
creatures.lore: A tall thin absence the shape of a walking person, visible only as the stars it is standing in front of going out in order. On the water it leaves no reflection at all, which is how it is found.

creatures.name: The Waning Wraith
creatures.lore: A person-shaped figure of thin silver light missing a clean curved bite from one side, and the bite is larger each time the eye comes back to it. Nobody has watched one long enough to see it end.

creatures.name: The Moon Below
creatures.lore: The moon's reflection, filling most of the lake, at a size nothing overhead accounts for. It holds still while the water moves, and it is oriented toward the shore rather than toward the sky.

creatures.name: Luna Plena, the Full Moon
creatures.lore: The full moon at the size the water has been showing it, arrived above the lake instead of in it, close enough that the shore has two of every shadow. Looking straight at it is the mistake.

creatures.name: Orrery Automaton
creatures.lore: A brass figure the height of a person that walks a fixed circuit between the standing rings, stopping at the same seven places every time and adjusting something at each. It has never once been seen to stop at an eighth.

creatures.name: Gear-Ghost
creatures.lore: The turning of a gear with no gear in it, holding its diameter in the air at about the width of a cartwheel. The teeth are visible only where they would be meshing, and they mesh on time.

creatures.name: Armature
creatures.lore: A single support arm off one of the great rings, torn loose at the hub and upright on its own, half again the height of a person. The windings along its length brighten steadily and then do not.

creatures.name: Arcflock
creatures.lore: Two dozen small discharges keeping loose formation about head height and moving together the way birds do, each one lasting no longer than a spark and replaced before it is missed.

creatures.name: Errant Ring
creatures.lore: A ring off the mechanism about the width of a doorway, rolling on its edge along a path it has worn into the floor. It corrects itself whenever it starts to fall, and it has been correcting itself for a very long time.

creatures.name: Sidereal Fault
creatures.lore: A seam in the air where the modelled sky and the real one do not agree, tall as the standing rings and no thicker than a held breath. Looking through it shows the same stars in the wrong places.

creatures.name: Escapement
creatures.lore: A toothed wheel and its pallet, mounted alone on a frame twice the height of a person, catching and releasing with a report you feel through the floor. Between the reports it does not move at all.

creatures.name: Long Division
creatures.lore: A column of worked figures hanging in the air at the height of a wall, each line shorter than the one above it, resolving downward at about the speed of a walking pace. The bottom line is never visible from where you are standing.

creatures.name: The Remainder
creatures.lore: The part of a figure that would not go in, kept to one side of the working and grown to about the size of a person while it waited. It is still being carried, and it is still owed.

creatures.name: The Calculation
creatures.lore: The whole working of the machine seen at once, filling the chamber from floor to broken roof, every surviving ring turning in it at a different rate. It does not notice being interrupted and it does not lose its place.

creatures.name: The Answer
creatures.lore: A single arrangement of light standing at the centre where the rings used to cross, about the size of a person and entirely still. It was not there on any previous visit, and it is complete.

creatures.name: Shadeless
creatures.lore: A person-shaped figure walking the flat with nothing on the ground beneath it, at a pace that neither hurries nor slows. Whatever took its shadow took nothing else, and it has kept walking since.

creatures.name: Sunstruck Pilgrim
creatures.lore: Wrapped to the eyes and still burnt through the cloth, walking a line it fixed on days ago and has not been able to see since. It reaches for you the way someone reaches for a wall in the dark.

creatures.name: Glasspan Crawler
creatures.lore: A low slab of salt fused to green glass by something that happened here once, crossing the pan at a walking pace and never turning aside for anything, including the road.

creatures.name: Mirage
creatures.lore: A stretch of standing water half a mile off that is still half a mile off when you reach where it was. Close up there is a shape in it, and the shape is the part that does not move away.

creatures.name: Kiln Moth
creatures.lore: Wings the colour of ash paper, thin enough to read light through and scorched along every edge already. It does not circle what burns it; it goes straight in, over and over, and does not stop.

creatures.name: Sun Templar
creatures.lore: Plate polished to a finish that has not dulled in whatever time it has stood out here, worn over nothing at all. It keeps the sun at its back, and it does that on every side of the field.

creatures.name: Prism Sentinel
creatures.lore: A standing wedge of clear sand-glass twice a person's height, every face true and none of them the same angle. What arrives at it comes apart and leaves in several directions at once.

creatures.name: Saltmarch Wraith
creatures.lore: A column of salt dust holding the shape of a column of people, moving along the old crossing at the pace of the slowest of them. It arrives all at once and never where the front of it was.

creatures.name: The Shadeless Hour
creatures.lore: The part of the day when nothing on the flat casts anything, walking about as a tall thin absence with the light going through it wrong. It is over quickly, and it takes something with it when it goes.

creatures.name: The Cold Shadow
creatures.lore: The whole of the cold this place should have, gathered into one shape the size of a rock shelf and lying where no rock shelf is. Nothing that walks into it comes out the far side warm.

creatures.name: Solar Deity
creatures.lore: Not a figure with light on it but the light itself, standing up off the pan at about the height of a person and holding that height. Looking directly at it is the last clear thing you do for a while.

creatures.name: Tidewrack Drowned
creatures.lore: They come up the flats at a walking pace, spaced evenly, keeping a line nobody has dressed for them in a very long time. Whatever they were drilled to do, they are still doing it, and they are still good at it.

creatures.name: Wrackcrab
creatures.lore: Broad as a cartwheel and almost flat, carrying a shell crusted over with the same weed the flats are named for. It does not retreat to water when the tide goes; it simply shuts, and waits for the water to come back to it.

creatures.name: Lowwater Thing
creatures.lore: A shallow spreading body of water that stayed behind when the rest of the sea left, warm enough to be unpleasant and deep enough to be a problem. It has an edge, and the edge moves.

creatures.name: Gullbone Flock
creatures.lore: Two dozen long-winged birds working the same stretch of flat, all turning together on nothing anyone on the ground can see. They are never out over the water early and never out over it late.

creatures.name: Spindrift
creatures.lore: A person-sized sheet of spray torn off a wave top that keeps going after the wave has finished, travelling flat and fast a hand above the sand. It is only ever there for as long as the gust is.

creatures.name: Tidal Empress
creatures.lore: A tall crowned figure standing out on the flats with the water gathered behind her at a height it has no business holding. She does not appear to be making it do that. She appears to be waiting with it.

creatures.name: Leviathan
creatures.lore: A back the length of a jetty breaking the shallow water and not finishing — there is more of it behind, and more again. It was never meant to be seen from above, and at low water there is nowhere else to see it from.

creatures.name: Maelstrom Horror
creatures.lore: A turning column of water standing in the channel between two bars, wide enough at the top to take a boat and narrow enough at the bottom to be a throat. Things that go into it do not come back down the channel.

creatures.name: The Turning
creatures.lore: Not water and not weather — the instant itself, standing still on the flat while everything around it reverses. Anyone caught out past the bars learns to feel it coming and still does not leave in time.

creatures.name: Kraken
creatures.lore: Uncovered rather than arrived — the low water simply stops being deep enough to hide it, and then there is a great deal of it lying across the flats between you and anywhere. It has been down there the entire time.

creatures.name: The Undertow
creatures.lore: There is nothing to look at. The water around your knees is going out the way it has gone out every day since before the shoals had a name, and it is taking the sand from under you while it goes, and it will not be hurried and cannot be argued with.

creatures.name: Crater Revenant
creatures.lore: A person, recognisably, standing in the bottom of a bowl they did not walk into. They fight the way someone trained fights — economically, without flourish, and without any apparent interest in stopping.

creatures.name: Sky-Iron Husk
creatures.lore: A hollow shell of pitted dark metal standing upright in the shape of whatever it was wrapped around on the way down. The inside is empty and has been for a long time. The outside is still cooling.

creatures.name: Fallpoint
creatures.lore: The last instant of something's descent, still happening, held at the spot where it met the ground. Looking directly at it is like looking at a sound. It is thin, it is bright, and it is not slowing down.

creatures.name: Scatterling
creatures.lore: One arrival that did not stay one thing, now a loose spread of fragments keeping rough company at about waist height. No piece of it is dangerous. All of it at once is a different question.

creatures.name: Cold Ejecta
creatures.lore: Debris thrown clear of a crater that has long since stopped being hot, still travelling on the push it was given. It has never once changed direction and it has never once come to rest.

creatures.name: The Zodiac Ascendant
creatures.lore: A wheel of twelve figures turning slowly on edge above the basin floor, each one a constellation drawn in hard white points. Whichever figure is at the top is the one that comes down, and the wheel is always turning.

creatures.name: Constellation Warden
creatures.lore: A figure outlined in fixed points of light, standing between the craters in a posture that has not altered in living memory. It is not guarding any one bowl. It is keeping the pattern of them.

creatures.name: Rift Walker
creatures.lore: Something tall that treats the distance between two places as a formality. It is at the far rim of the bowl, and then it is not, and nothing covered the ground in between.

creatures.name: Echo of the Between
creatures.lore: The repetition of something that has not happened here yet, arriving out of the empty distance the craters were aimed across. It is quieter than the thing it is repeating, and it is earlier.

creatures.name: The Next One
creatures.lore: A mass overhead large enough to have an underside, lit along one edge and growing at a rate that can be measured against the horizon without instruments. Everything on the ground here is a record of the last one.

creatures.name: What Landed
creatures.lore: Something the size of a curled person at the centre of the deepest bowl, unmarked by the journey and oriented, very precisely, towards whoever has just come over the rim. It has been waiting the way a thing waits when waiting costs it nothing.

creatures.name: Eclipse Herald
creatures.lore: A robed shape that walks the crest itself rather than either side of it, lit hard along one flank and entirely unlit along the other, with no softening anywhere between the two. It never steps off the line in either direction.

creatures.name: Crestline Warden
creatures.lore: A broad, sun-scoured figure that patrols the lit side of the ridge and never once descends the other. It moves people the way a gate moves them: in one direction, and without discussion.

creatures.name: Nightglare
creatures.lore: A knot of hard white light about the size of a head that holds its position relative to a traveler no matter which way they turn, well down inside a valley that has never had a sun in it. Looking away does not help and looking at it helps less.

creatures.name: Coldlight Swarm
creatures.lore: A loose cloud of pale motes the size of a large dog when it is gathered, each one bright enough to see by and none of them warm. It comes apart and reassembles constantly, so nothing about it stays in one place long enough to be struck.

creatures.name: Shadowpitch Stalker
creatures.lore: A low four-limbed shape a little longer than a person is tall, so black against black rock that it is only ever seen as an absence crossing something paler. It keeps entirely to the unlit side and closes the last of the distance faster than the rest of it.

creatures.name: Solar Archon
creatures.lore: A tall armoured figure half again the height of a person, its plate polished to the point where the desert behind it is legible in the surface. It stands on the crest facing outward, as though the valley below were something it had been posted against.

creatures.name: The Crest
creatures.lore: A length of ridge perhaps thirty feet of it, standing up off the ground as a single slab and moving at the pace a shadow moves. The lit face and the unlit face meet along its top edge in a line with no gradient in it at all.

creatures.name: Both-Sided Thing
creatures.lore: A person-sized figure split top to bottom down its exact centre, one half bleached the colour of the desert floor and the other the flat black of the valley, with nothing blended along the seam. Whichever half is turned toward you is the one doing the work.

creatures.name: Duskmarch
creatures.lore: The shadow line itself, walking the valley floor at the pace the day sets and never varying from it. Anything standing where it has already passed finds the ground colder than the ground a stride behind them.

creatures.name: The Last Light
creatures.lore: The final hand-width of sun on the top of the crest, held there long after the angle should have taken it, and about as tall as the ridge it is standing on. It does not descend into the valley and it has never needed to.

creatures.name: The First Dark
creatures.lore: The whole unlit side of the valley, standing up. It has the height of the scarp and no edges anywhere on it, and the only way to know where it is at any moment is by what has stopped being visible.

creatures.name: Glasswright
creatures.lore: A lean figure of fitted plate-glass panes held in a lead armature, still wearing the apron shape of the trade it died in. It squares up to you the way a craftsman squares up to a job, and it does not hurry any part of it.

creatures.name: Noonmark
creatures.lore: A person-sized wedge of hard white light standing on the hillside where a lens happens to be pointed, edged as cleanly as a shadow is edged. It has wings only in the sense that the edges of it beat once in a while, and it is gone by the middle of the afternoon.

creatures.name: Palimpsest
creatures.lore: A standing sheet of vellum about the height of a person, scraped thin in patches and written over so many times that no single hand is legible. The oldest layer keeps surfacing through the newest, and it is the one still moving.

creatures.name: Readerless
creatures.lore: Several dozen loose written leaves travelling together at about chest height, holding no shape for longer than a step, none of them bound to any of the others. Every one of them is face-up and none of them has been read.

creatures.name: Lensfly
creatures.lore: A hand-span of ground lens on four thin legs, skating across the roof tiles and turning to keep its face toward the sun. It is never where the glare says it is, because the glare is a moment behind it.

creatures.name: The Last Reader
creatures.lore: A seated figure a head taller than a person, robed in smoked glass panes with a reading-frame still braced across its lap. It stands to meet you without putting the frame down, and it keeps its place with one finger the entire time.

creatures.name: Aperture
creatures.lore: A ring of overlapping brass leaves twice the height of a person, standing upright on the hillside with nothing holding it there. The opening at its centre narrows and widens on its own schedule, and the light behind it is much older than the light around it.

creatures.name: Burnt Index
creatures.lore: A tall freestanding case of index cards charred black from one end, the unburnt half still filed in perfect order and the burnt half still holding its shape as ash. It knows exactly where everything was, which is not the same as where anything is.

creatures.name: The Marginalia
creatures.lore: A dense crowd of small annotating hands, each one no larger than a child's, crawling in the blank space at the edges of everything and writing steadily inward. Whatever they are commenting on, they have been commenting on it for centuries and they are not finished.

creatures.name: What Was Written
creatures.lore: A column of standing script four storeys tall, every line of it in the same unhurried hand, holding together without a page to be written on. It reads from the top down and the ground beneath it is the only part of the hillside with nothing recorded on it.

creatures.name: What Is Left Of It
creatures.lore: Not a body — the hillside at noon with every lens aimed at the same spot, and the shape standing in that spot is only where the light has nothing left to go through. Looking at it directly costs you the rest of the afternoon.

creatures.name: Stratum Warden
creatures.lore: Stone laid down in bands, each one a different colour and a different age, standing across the shaft in the order it was made. It does not move out of the way, and it does not come apart anywhere except at a seam.

creatures.name: Constellate
creatures.lore: A scatter of star-points holding a loose shape about the size of a person, none of them still long enough to be counted twice. It arrives before you have finished counting it, and it arrives in pieces.

creatures.name: Fadelight
creatures.lore: The last light of a star that went out before any of this rock was laid down, still arriving and still exactly on time. There is nothing left of it to kill, and it can still end you.

creatures.name: Corebiter
creatures.lore: A blunt, patient thing that goes through a seam the way water goes through a crack, only slower and with teeth. It has never been seen to hurry, and it has never been seen to stop.

creatures.name: Deadreckoner
creatures.lore: It navigates by stars that no longer exist and is still mostly right, which is worse than being wrong. Every bearing it takes is honest, and every bearing it takes is out of date.

creatures.name: Stonefall Herald
creatures.lore: It arrives a little before the rock does, every time, and has never once been early for anything else. By the time you have understood what it is announcing, the face is already coming away.

creatures.name: Bedrock Colossus
creatures.lore: The last layer, the one with nothing under it, standing up. There is no going around it, because there is nothing beside it to go around into.

creatures.name: Nadir
creatures.lore: The lowest point of the shaft, which is a place and is also looking at you. Everything in this zone has been falling toward it since the rock was laid down.

creatures.name: The Long Count
creatures.lore: A tally kept in a notation nobody now reads, still being added to, and the number is about you. It has been counting moons since long before there was anyone here to miss one.

creatures.name: The Overburden
creatures.lore: The whole weight of rock that sits on top of a seam, arrived at the bottom of the shaft and standing up in it. It is not fast, it has never needed to be, and nothing it settles onto comes back up.

creatures.name: The Buried Constellation
creatures.lore: An old pattern of light still alight down here, entire, in an arrangement that matches nothing overhead. It refuses to be past tense, and where you put your guard is not where it lands.

creatures.name: Unfinished Scholar
creatures.lore: A figure in a reader's gown at a lectern that is not there, working steadily through a passage with one hand out for the next page. It has not stopped to eat, or to look up, or to notice that the room around it ran out some time ago.

creatures.name: Stairhead
creatures.lore: The top four treads and the landing of a staircase, squared pale timber and stone, moving as one piece at about the speed somebody climbs. There is no lower flight under it and there is no room at the top, and neither of those has ever slowed it.

creatures.name: Chalkwraith
creatures.lore: A loose person-shaped drift of chalk dust that holds together at roughly the height of somebody working at a board, one arm always raised. It writes continuously on whatever it is nearest, at the speed of somebody who has done this lecture many times.

creatures.name: Marginal Note
creatures.lore: A dense column of small handwriting standing upright in the air at about the width of a page margin and the height of a person, with no page beside it. More is added to it while you watch, in the same hand, at the same size.

creatures.name: Emeritus
creatures.lore: A very old reader, thin to the point of translucence, still seated in the chair the school gave them and still turned toward the front of a hall that no longer has a front. Everyone who could have told them to go home left a long time ago.

creatures.name: The Fourth Item
creatures.lore: A line of writing about the length of a forearm, hanging at eye height with nothing holding it up, in a hand that matches the three lines above it on the wall. Reading the first three takes a moment. Reading this one does not finish.

creatures.name: Mana Golem
creatures.lore: A broad seated figure half again the height of a person, built out of cooled grey-violet slag in poured layers, each one flowed over the last. It is warm to stand near. The heat is coming from somewhere near the middle of it and has not run out.

creatures.name: Arcane Chimera
creatures.lore: A four-limbed animal about the size of a large hound whose parts do not agree with each other — three different coats, two different gaits, a head that belongs to none of it. Every join is clean and deliberate. Somebody was very good at this and did not stop.

creatures.name: Spell Weaver
creatures.lore: A tall narrow figure standing at a loom taller than it is, working with both hands at a speed that is hard to watch. The cloth coming off the loom is already the width of the room and there is no sign of it being cut, or gathered, or wanted.

creatures.name: The Archmage
creatures.lore: An old man in the plain grey of a working scholar rather than the robes of an office, standing in the middle of the floor with no book in his hands and no need of one. He is entirely willing to explain what he found, and the explanation is the problem.

creatures.name: The Last Three Items
creatures.lore: Three lines at the bottom of the syllabus still on the wall, in the same hand as the rest of it, standing out from the plaster far enough to cast a shadow. The first eleven items are a course of study. These are not, and they are what the course was for.

creatures.name: Reliquary Keeper
creatures.lore: A robed figure of ordinary height that stands at one of the wall niches and does not look away from it, stepping aside only far enough to let a person past and then stepping back. Whatever the niche held is not in it.

creatures.name: Censer-Wraith
creatures.lore: A column of standing smoke the height of a person, leaning out of one of the hanging censers without ever fully leaving it. It thickens toward the corridor and thins toward the censer, and it has been doing that long enough to have stained the ceiling.

creatures.name: The Unleft
creatures.lore: A person-shaped absence in the dust of the floor, upright, that the eye reads as a figure only because the dust around it is undisturbed. There is more of it the longer it is looked at and none of it when it is not.

creatures.name: Bone-Reliquary
creatures.lore: A gilt casket the size of a man, standing on end and walking on the stubs of its own carrying-poles, its lid swung back on one hinge. What is inside it is arranged, and arranged carefully, and it is not one person.

creatures.name: Corridor Crawler
creatures.lore: Long and low and about the length of two people, moving along the join between wall and floor rather than down the middle. It always arrives from the warm end, and it is warm itself to stand near.

creatures.name: Antechoir
creatures.lore: The room before the choir, walking: a half-circle of carved stalls two people high, curved inward as though around a singer, with nobody in any of the seats. It keeps the shape of an audience.

creatures.name: Reliquary Colossus
creatures.lore: A reliquary built to the scale of the corridor rather than of a hand, filling it wall to wall, gold-fitted over pale stone and moving at the pace of something that has never needed to hurry. Every face of it is a door and none of them opens.

creatures.name: The Second Hand
creatures.lore: One arm and one shoulder, person-scaled, reaching out of the wall up to the elbow and working at something just beyond where it can reach. It has taken the gold off four feet of fitting on either side of itself and has not stopped.

creatures.name: Warm Middle
creatures.lore: No edge and no surface — a stretch of corridor perhaps thirty paces long that is blood-warm to stand in and cools from both ends inward. It is in a different part of the corridor each time anyone comes back.

creatures.name: What Was Consecrated
creatures.lore: The far end of the corridor, arriving: floor, walls and ceiling together, pale stone banded in gold, moving toward the entrance at the speed of a slow walk and taking the corridor with it. There is no gap at any edge to go around.

creatures.name: What Did Not Leave It Alone
creatures.lore: Whatever is standing there is the size of a person and is made out of what it has taken off the walls — gold, stone, cloth, and the marks of the work itself. It stops when it is watched and it is further along every time it is looked at again.

creatures.name: Umbral Devourer
creatures.lore: A mouth-shaped gap in the dark about the size of a person, with no creature around it and no edge to it anywhere except at the front. What it closes on is simply less than it was.

creatures.name: Edgewalker
creatures.lore: A person walking the exact line where the light stops, one boot lit and one boot not, at a pace that never varies. It has been keeping to that line long enough to have worn it.

creatures.name: Considered Ice
creatures.lore: A standing slab of black ice twice a person's height with every face flat and every angle the same angle. Nothing has melted off it and nothing has been added to it since it was put there.

creatures.name: Nightspill
creatures.lore: Dark running downhill over the ice the way water would, ankle-deep and spreading, finding the low ground first. It arrives at you in the order the ground says it should.

creatures.name: Thoughtform
creatures.lore: A person-sized outline that is entirely edge and no interior, the ice behind it perfectly visible through the middle. Held still it is exact; move your head and part of it is not there.

creatures.name: Umbral Knight
creatures.lore: Full plate a head taller than a person, matte black on every surface including the places armour is always bright. It keeps the dark in front of it the way a shield is kept in front.

creatures.name: The Edge
creatures.lore: The boundary of the dark itself, stood up on end and made to hold still — a flat vertical face as wide as the pass and only as thick as a line. Nothing goes round it because there is no round.

creatures.name: Void Stalker
creatures.lore: Lean, long-limbed and taller than a person, built entirely of the absence rather than of anything in it. It picks one of a group at the start and afterwards there were never any others.

creatures.name: Eclipse Weaver
creatures.lore: A low wide thing of many thin legs working across the face of the pass, drawing something behind it that the light does not come back through. It has covered a great deal of ground already.

creatures.name: Nightbringer
creatures.lore: A tall robed figure that walks the pass at an unhurried pace, and the dark is not around it so much as arriving in the places it has decided on, slightly before it gets there.

moves.name: Put the Dark Where It Goes

creatures.name: What Was Thought About
creatures.lore: Not a figure in the dark but the dark holding one particular shape, about the size of a house and entirely deliberate about every part of its outline. Looking at it, you can tell it was chosen.

creatures.name: The Dictating Hand
creatures.lore: A bare forearm and hand at about head height with nothing above the wrist and nobody behind it, holding a pen and working steadily across a page that is not there. It does not stop when you arrive; it simply begins a fresh line.

creatures.name: Blankspine
creatures.lore: A standing book the height of a child, bound and clasped and entirely empty, its covers opening a finger's width and closing again at no particular rhythm. Whatever is inside it has never been written and is waiting to be.

creatures.name: Footnote
creatures.lore: A low band of small dense script travelling along the floor at ankle height, wider than a person and never more than a hand deep. It refers to something further up that you cannot see from here.

creatures.name: Erratum
creatures.lore: A single loose slip of paper about the size of a hand, travelling upright and at speed, carrying one short line in a tidier script than anything around it. It arrives before the sentence it is fixing has finished.

creatures.name: Ink-Drinker
creatures.lore: A stooped, soft-edged shape about the size of a large dog, moving along the shelves with its mouth to the spines. The pages behind it are clean. It is fuller at the end of a row than at the start of one.

creatures.name: The Index
creatures.lore: A freestanding wall of small drawered card-cases two people high and as wide again, every drawer sliding a little way out and back as it works. It finds what it is looking for faster than anything that size should.

creatures.name: Colophon
creatures.lore: A squat block of dark polished stone the height of a person, one face cut with a single deep mark and the rest left rough. It has been set down at the end of a row the way a full stop is set down, and the row has continued past it regardless.

creatures.name: Redaction
creatures.lore: A long hard-edged bar of absolute black, about as tall as a person and no thicker than a finger, that crosses the space between you in one movement. What it has been over is not damaged. It is simply no longer there.

creatures.name: The Amanuensis
creatures.lore: A seated, stooped figure in plain clerk's dress, taller than a person would be standing, writing without pause and without looking down. It has been taking this down since before you came in and it is already ahead of you.

creatures.name: The Record
creatures.lore: A run of bound volumes standing shoulder to shoulder across the whole width of the hall and up past where a ceiling would be, each one the size of a door. The run is longer every time you look along it, and it is longer at the end you have already passed.

creatures.name: The Author
creatures.lore: Not a body — the dark between two shelves, as tall as the shelves go, with the writing happening inside it at a rate you can hear. Nothing holds the pen and nothing needs to. It is the only thing here that knows your name, and it learned it a moment ago.

creatures.name: Causeway Warden
creatures.lore: A broad armoured figure standing square in the middle of the road rather than beside it, pale stone and pale metal gone the colour of the causeway it has not stepped off. It does not advance and it has never been seen to sit down.

creatures.name: Marker-Sworn
creatures.lore: A robed figure of ordinary height carrying a short rule and a pot of whitewash, met walking between two markers. It finishes the stroke it was making before it turns around, and it picks the stroke up again afterwards.

creatures.name: Meltwater Choir
creatures.lore: The channel beside the road running over stone that was cut to make it sound like that. There is no body in it anywhere. It is loudest in the afternoon and it has been in tune for four hundred years.

creatures.name: Votive
creatures.lore: A single small flame standing upright at head height beside a marker, with no lamp under it and nothing feeding it. Somebody lit it on purpose. It leans toward whoever is nearest the way a candle leans toward a draught.

creatures.name: Pilgrim's Remnant
creatures.lore: A pilgrim's pack, still roped and still full, standing upright on the road at about chest height with nobody inside the straps. It is travelling uphill at a walking pace and it has not put itself down once.

creatures.name: Milestone
creatures.lore: A road-marker twice the height of the ones behind it, cut from the same pale stone and lettered in the same hand, standing in the middle of the causeway where no marker has ever stood. The number on it is the next one.

creatures.name: Vestal Warden
creatures.lore: A seated armoured figure half again as tall as a person, occupying a shelter built into the roadside for exactly one occupant, with a small lamp burning in the niche beside it. The shelter was built around it and the lamp has never gone out.

creatures.name: Seraph Judicant
creatures.lore: A tall winged figure that arrives already facing you, holding a plain unrolled writ in both hands and reading from it without looking down. It has the bearing of something carrying out a decision taken somewhere else a long time ago.

creatures.name: The Upkeep
creatures.lore: Not a figure — the work itself, visible as a moving patch of road that is cleaner than the road around it, about the size of a person kneeling. It is always a little further along than it was, and it has never been in front of anybody.

creatures.name: The Keeper of the Road
creatures.lore: Four storeys of pale road-stone in roughly the shape of a person stooping to their work, carrying a straight edge as long as the causeway is wide. Every marker behind it is true. Every marker ahead of it is about to be.

creatures.name: The Hierophant Eternal
creatures.lore: A vested figure four storeys tall standing at the head of the causeway facing back down it, hands folded, entirely still. It has given one instruction in its life and everything on this road is still carrying it out.

creatures.name: Orchard Warden
creatures.lore: Set at the foot of one tree to watch it, and has watched it long enough that the bark has grown around where it stands. It does not patrol and it does not follow. It steps in front of the tree.

creatures.name: Windfall
creatures.lore: Fruit already on the ground, perfect, unbruised, and warmer than fruit on the ground has any business being. Nothing has taken a piece out of it and nothing has walked on it.

creatures.name: Whisperling
creatures.lore: A small coiled thing high in the branches that talks, pleasantly, and offers you something you had not thought to want. It waits for an answer and it is content to keep waiting.

creatures.name: Chorister Vine
creatures.lore: A vine still singing the hours to an empty cloister, on time, in a form of the office nobody has used in an age. It finishes the hour it is on before it turns to look at you.

creatures.name: Thornpenitent
creatures.lore: A briar that grew through and around someone kneeling, and kept the posture after there stopped being a reason for it. It rises out of the kneel to swing and it goes back down afterwards.

creatures.name: The Last Gardener
creatures.lore: The only mortal still inside, in working clothes gone the colour of the beds, carrying tools that have been maintained. It watches you walk the path and says nothing until you reach for something.

creatures.name: Root Matriarch
creatures.lore: The oldest stock in the orchard, and every other tree in here is a runner off it. What is above ground is the smaller half of it, and the ground for a long way around belongs to the other half.

creatures.name: Cherub of the Turning Blade
creatures.lore: A blade at the gate turning end over end on nothing, fast enough to read as a disc and slow enough to count. Whatever is holding it is the same colour as the air. It has never once stopped turning.

creatures.name: The Kept Vow
creatures.lore: An oath with a body. Nobody remembers the wording and it has not needed to be reminded, and the shape it holds is roughly the shape of the person who gave it.

creatures.name: Guardian of the World Tree
creatures.lore: It stands in the gateway with the tree behind it and it does not move aside for anything. There is no anger anywhere in it and there is nothing to say to it. It was left here and it stayed.

creatures.name: The Serpent in the Branches
creatures.lore: It is already in the canopy over the path when you notice it, and it has been letting you notice it for a while. Nothing about the way it addresses you is a threat, and it does not repeat itself.

creatures.name: The Held Door
creatures.lore: Stone that has been shut long enough for root to grow into the seam, so that the rock and the green are now one fitting. Nothing has come through it in a very long time and it has stopped expecting anything to.

creatures.name: Ashlight
creatures.lore: A fire that gives off heat, and smoke, and no light whatsoever, burning in a sconce nobody lit. Standing close to it is exactly as warm as standing close to a fire and exactly as dark as standing in a cellar.

creatures.name: The Kept Watch
