creatures.lore: Still on post, still in the armour, still facing the direction it was told to face, which is not the direction you came from. It turns to deal with you and you can see the effort that costs it.

creatures.name: Nightcurrent
creatures.lore: Moonlight arriving along the ironwork the way current arrives along a wire, and reaching the floor at the same time you do. Every rail in the hall carries a little of it and none of them carries all of it.

creatures.name: The Last Applicant
creatures.lore: Somebody else who came all this way to be let back in, and who is still here, and who is still asking. The case it is making is a good one, and it has been making it for long enough that the making is all that is left.

creatures.name: The Basin
creatures.lore: The first ground, arriving with everything it taught you and none of the patience. It fights the way the woods fought and it is no longer interested in whether you are ready.

creatures.name: The Range
creatures.lore: The rock you crossed, standing across the way again, in no hurry at all. It does not chase and it does not need to; the distance between you and it is the whole of its argument.

creatures.name: The Shelf
creatures.lore: The high air, which never had enough in it, and which now has none. It is a flat ledge of nothing standing upright, and the drop on the far side of it is the part that is paying attention.

creatures.name: The Climb
creatures.lore: The last stretch, which was always above your level and was always answered with what you were carrying. It is still above your level and it would like to know what you brought this time.

creatures.name: Totality
creatures.lore: The moment the light is completely covered, standing upright and taking up the doorway from jamb to jamb. There is no gap around it and there is no expression on it, and the dark it is making is the only dark in the hall with an edge.

creatures.name: Procarius, the Eclipsed
creatures.lore: A tall man in dark robes standing in the last of the hall with nothing behind him, waiting without impatience for you to finish getting here. Everything else in the Citadel was between you and him; he is between you and the door.

items.name: Oak Log
items.lore: Cut green, it weeps for a week. Hearthwood seasons it in the open because the smoke gets into anything dried indoors.

items.name: Bindweed Fibre
items.lore: Strong out of all proportion to its thickness. The trick is cutting it before it notices.

items.name: Flora Dust
items.lore: What a growing thing leaves when it is unmade faster than it grew.

items.name: Flora Shard
items.lore: Dust that settled somewhere it was not disturbed.

items.name: Flora Crystal
items.lore: It is warm, and it does not stop being warm.

items.name: Forager's Ration
items.lore: Filling. That is the whole of its reputation.

items.name: Oak Circlet
items.lore: A band of green wood, bent and pinned. It tightens as it dries.

items.name: Oak Quarterstaff
items.lore: Season it a year and it stops arguing. Nobody seasons it a year.

items.name: Oak Wand
items.lore: Light enough to forget, which is the point of it.

items.name: Oak Knot
items.lore: A burl worked smooth, kept in the off hand. Carvers say the tangle remembers which way it grew, and pointing it settles the question.

items.name: Bindweed Hood
items.lore: It keeps the sun off, and the wood does the rest.

items.name: Bindweed Robe
items.lore: Woven wet and left to shrink. It fits by the third day.

items.name: Bindweed Leggings
items.lore: They whistle faintly in a wind. No one has explained it.

items.name: Bindweed Boots
items.lore: Quiet on leaf litter, which in this wood cuts both ways.

items.name: Bindweed Gloves
items.lore: The weave tightens when you grip. Let go slowly.

items.name: Sporecap Mantle
items.lore: Still shedding. Field note: the spores settle on whatever is nearest and the wearer is rarely nearest.

items.name: Heartwood Staff
items.lore: Cut from the centre, which is why it is warm. It is still growing, very slowly, in whichever direction it is pointed.

items.name: Proof of the Woods
items.lore: A knot of root that kept growing after it was cut. The guard on the north road has seen a hundred and still turns each one over twice.

items.name: Fawnhide
items.lore: Thin, and it takes a dye better than anything else this close to the water. Nobody in Hearthwood will say where they get it.

items.name: Sapwort
items.lore: Grows with its feet in the brook and its head in the sun, and tastes of neither.

items.name: Aqua Dust
items.lore: What water leaves when it is broken faster than it can close.

items.name: Aqua Shard
items.lore: Dust that stood in one place long enough to set.

items.name: Aqua Crystal
items.lore: It is cold, and it does not stop being cold.

items.name: Sapwort Draught
items.lore: Tastes like the underside of a leaf. Apprentices carry two and use neither, which is its own kind of lesson.

items.name: Fawnhide Belt
items.lore: Soft enough to sleep in. It will hold a bottle where you can reach it, which is worth more than it sounds.

items.name: Brookstone Pendant
items.lore: A river pebble with a hole worn through it, strung on gut. Looking through the hole shows the same world, calmer.

items.name: Proof of the Brook
items.lore: A pale river stone that has not warmed since it left the water. The guard on the north road weighs it in his palm and takes his time.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.lore: The hills here rust green. Forgeholm pays for it by the sack and does not say what the hurry is.

items.name: Tuskhide
items.lore: Scarred, singed, and thicker than a door. Whatever wears it walks through embers on purpose.

items.name: Pyro Dust
items.lore: What a burning thing leaves when it is put out before it finished.

items.name: Pyro Shard
items.lore: Dust that banked itself and went on quietly burning.

items.name: Pyro Crystal
items.lore: It is hot, and it does not cool.

items.name: Tuskhide Belt
items.lore: Two bottles and room for a third. The buckle outweighs the knife.

items.name: Cinder Loop
items.lore: A ring of char that never quite goes out. Wearing it feels like the moment before a pot boils over.

items.name: Proof of the Foothills
items.lore: A plate of black glass with the heat still somewhere inside it. The guard on the north road holds each one up to the light before he nods.

items.name: Bogflax Fibre
items.lore: Retted in the mire by the mire. Cloth of it never fully dries, and never quite burns either.

items.name: Fenroot
items.lore: Bitter enough to make your eyes water at arm's length. The herbalists of Galehaven buy every scrap and boil it with the windows open.

items.name: Amber
items.lore: Light that went into a tree and never came back out. Sometimes there is a wing in it.

items.name: Bogflax Hood
items.lore: Keeps the rain out. The mire finds another way in.

items.name: Bogflax Robe
items.lore: Heavy when wet, and it is always wet. You stop noticing.

items.name: Bogflax Leggings
items.lore: Mud to the knee is the local dye lot.

items.name: Bogflax Boots
items.lore: The mire keeps boots. These are the kind it gives back.

items.name: Bogflax Gloves
items.lore: Waxed against the wet. Grip first, apologise later.

items.name: Wickerbound Ring
items.lore: Willow withies in a knot that took someone a whole winter. Cut it and it grows closed by morning.

items.name: Amber Band
items.lore: Bronze wire wound three times round a chip of amber. Somebody's first try, and it holds.

items.name: Amber Drop
items.lore: One bead of amber on a bronze loop. Warm against the skin long after the fire is out.

items.name: Amber Ring
items.lore: A band of amber set in a bronze rim, cloudy on one side where the mire got into it first.

items.name: Amber Pendant
items.lore: Three drops of amber on a bronze chain, the middle one with a wing in it. The wing is the part people ask about.

items.name: Birch Log
items.lore: First back after the burn, straight as a rule and pale as paper. The vale is a plantation nobody planted.

items.name: Brookmint
items.lore: Cold on the tongue even in this valley. It grows where the streams cut through the ash, greener than anything around it.

items.name: Charcoal
items.lore: The vale makes its own. Gathering it is not burning anything that was not already burned.

items.name: Brookmint Tonic
items.lore: Drink it and count. The cold goes down, turns around, and comes back up as warmth over the next little while.

items.name: Birch Quarterstaff
items.lore: Springy where oak is stubborn. It gives, then gives back.

items.name: Birch Wand
items.lore: Peels itself a little more each week, like it is in a hurry.

items.name: Birch Knot
items.lore: A pale whorl with a dark centre. It warms in the hand it likes.

items.name: The Charlock
items.lore: A seed case of black glass on a charred stem. Every morning it has flowered again, and every evening the flower is ash.

items.name: Tin Ore
items.lore: Grey ore veined bright where a chisel caught it wrong, common enough that the diggers barely bent down to pick it up.

items.name: Quarry Jasper
items.lore: Red banding cut square through a terrace face, squarer than anything the mountain grows on its own.

items.name: Geo Dust
items.lore: What breaks off a standing stone before the stone itself gives way.

items.name: Geo Shard
items.lore: Dust that held its shape long enough to grow edges.

items.name: Geo Crystal
items.lore: It is heavy, and it does not get lighter.

items.name: Hardtack
items.lore: Baked hard enough to survive a quarry cart, and eaten the same way — in pieces, with effort.

items.name: Bronze Ingot
items.lore: Copper and tin gone into the crucible together and come out neither, holding an edge better than either one alone.

items.name: Overseer's Seal
items.lore: A signet worn smooth in one groove and sharp everywhere else, exactly like something used to press its will into stone and nothing else.

items.name: The Given Weight
items.lore: The precise mass the hole is missing, worn on a chain, and heavier than its size has any right to be.

items.name: Jasper Ring
items.lore: A slab of red jasper in an iron collar, squared off with the same tools that cut the steps.

items.name: Jasper Pendant
items.lore: A plumb-bob of polished jasper on an iron chain. It hangs dead straight whichever way you lean.

items.name: Yew Log
items.lore: The only trees on the steppe, and every one of them leaning the same way. Cut with the lean, not against it, or the grain fights you the whole way through.

items.name: Tussock Flax
items.lore: Wiry stalk grown low and dense, in tussocks that have learned to grow around each other rather than up. Tough as rope once it is stripped and dried.

items.name: Aero Dust
items.lore: What a moving thing leaves when the wind gets there first.

items.name: Aero Shard
items.lore: Dust that caught on something and stopped moving, briefly.

items.name: Aero Crystal
items.lore: It is moving, and it does not stop.

items.name: Yew Quarterstaff
items.lore: Straight-grained where the tree was not, because the carver chose the one branch that never learned to lean. Heavier than it looks.

items.name: Yew Wand
items.lore: Trimmed thin enough to whip in the wind and not break, which is the whole test a Yew wand has to pass before it is sold.

items.name: Yew Knot
items.lore: A burl carved from a lean-side branch, where the grain knots up from decades of holding against the same wind.

items.name: Tussock Hood
items.lore: Woven tight enough that the wind whistles instead of getting in.

items.name: Tussock Robe
items.lore: Layered flax against the chest, thick enough to break a gust.

items.name: Tussock Leggings
items.lore: Cut long, so the hem does not catch and drag you sideways.

items.name: Tussock Boots
items.lore: Soled thick and laced tight. Standing still in them still feels like leaning into something.

items.name: Tussock Gloves
items.lore: Palms toughened from bracing against things that keep moving.

items.name: Leanstone Charm
items.lore: A finger-length sliver worn from the windward face of a leaning stone. Held loosely, it wants to point the same direction every time.

items.name: The Long Lean
items.lore: Windgrass grown thick and combed flat, worn over the shoulders like the steppe itself decided to stop resisting for you instead. It has been leaning the same way since it was cut.

items.name: Seawrack Fibre
items.lore: The tideline's own rope, laid out in long dark ropes and salt-cured by the weather before anyone gets to it. Stiff until it is worked.

items.name: Saltwort
items.lore: A low, fleshy herb that grows only where the spray reaches and nowhere the spray does not. Bites back the way the ocean does.

items.name: Electro Dust
items.lore: What a struck thing leaves after the light is already gone.

items.name: Electro Shard
items.lore: Dust that held its charge a moment longer than the rest.

items.name: Electro Crystal
items.lore: It is live, and it does not discharge.

items.name: Saltwort Draught
items.lore: Bitter, briny, and it clears the head fast. Galehaven sailors carry two and swear by both.

items.name: Seawrack Hood
items.lore: Salt-stiff and close-fitting. It keeps the spray out of the eyes.

items.name: Seawrack Robe
items.lore: Woven tight against the wind off the water. Never quite dries.

items.name: Seawrack Leggings
items.lore: Salt crusts white along every seam by the second wearing.

items.name: Seawrack Boots
items.lore: Soled for wet rock. You stop thinking about your footing in them.

items.name: Seawrack Gloves
items.lore: Thick enough to close a fist around bare wire without noticing.

items.name: Fulgurite Pendant
items.lore: A shard of fused glass on a plaited cord, dark and faintly branching, still warm at the core the way a struck thing stays warm long after the strike.

items.name: Uplight
items.lore: A wand of fused glass, branching like a root at the tip, that never stops feeling faintly live in the hand. It does not glow so much as it is always about to.

items.name: Rimepelt
items.lore: Thick fur gone white and stiff with frost that never fully thaws, even carried indoors. It holds the cold the way it once held in the warmth.

items.name: Hoarlichen
items.lore: Grey-green scale grown flat against black rock, the only living colour in the pass. It keeps growing at temperatures that should have finished it.

items.name: Everice
items.lore: Ice caught inside the rock itself, clear as glass and never once warmed by anything the black walls have done since. It comes free in one clean piece or not at all.

items.name: Rimepelt Belt
items.lore: Three loops stitched into rimepelt gone stiff enough to hold its shape on its own. Cold to the touch, always, no matter how long it has been worn.

items.name: Rimebound Ring
items.lore: A band of clear ice-shot stone that has never once cracked, worn by people who swore the cold in it was doing something for them. They may have been right.

items.name: The Holdfast
items.lore: A grip of stone-grey rimestone worn at the throat, cut the shape kelp uses to anchor itself against a current that would otherwise take it. Whatever it is holding onto, it has not let go yet.

items.name: Rowan Log
items.lore: Mountain ash above the treeline, which should not be possible — and yet here it stands, twisted hard by the wind and pale under the bark, one of the only living things taller than a person this high up.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.lore: Rust-red rock that the storm has been finding for a very long time — every vein runs true to where the last strike landed, and the next one will find it again.

items.name: Hum Quartz
items.lore: Quartz with a note in it. Strike it wrong and the note stops; strike it right and it rings on for longer than seems reasonable, held somewhere inside the crystal rather than in the air.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.lore: Ore gone into the crucible and come out true, holding a straighter edge than the rock it was cut from ever promised.

items.name: Rowan Quarterstaff
items.lore: Cut from wood that spent its whole life arguing with the wind and never lost. Lighter than Yew, and it holds an edge of white light along the grain after a strike that takes a moment to fade.

items.name: Rowan Wand
items.lore: Trimmed thin and true from a straight run of grain, still faintly warm from wherever it was standing. The first wand in the game with somewhere to set a gem.

items.name: Rowan Knot
items.lore: A burl grown tight and hard where the tree fought a bad lean for years. Carved smooth on one face; the socket is cut into the other, where the grain runs deepest.

items.name: Countstone Pendant
items.lore: A finger of Hum Quartz on a plaited cord that has never once gone quiet, its note quickening the closer the cloud overhead gets to lighting again. You learn to time your breathing to it.

items.name: Groundfault Grips
items.lore: Gloves worn by whoever stood closest to the ground the last time it took the whole charge at once. The seams still carry a hairline of live white light, and they have never once let a strike through to the hand.

items.name: Obsidian
items.lore: Black glass where the floor sheared clean and cooled too fast to crystallise, sharp along every broken edge and sharper than it looks.

items.name: Firesalt
items.lore: A crust of pale mineral left behind at a vent's lip, where the heat leaves something solid on its way out. Bitter, and warm long after it is pocketed.

items.name: Emberhide
items.lore: A hide that never fully cooled, dull orange still showing through the black in a scatter of hairline cracks whenever it flexes.

items.name: Emberhide Belt
items.lore: A wide strap of Emberhide worn low, four loops sewn into it and still faintly warm to the touch no matter how long it has hung on a peg.

items.name: Firstmelt Loop
items.lore: A ring cast in one motion from rock that was still moving when it set, its band never quite closing into a true circle. Warm, and unwilling to let go of a grip once it has one.

items.name: The Long Cooling
items.lore: A circlet of polished obsidian, worn smooth in one groove around the brow and still sharp everywhere else. It is still cooling; it will always still be cooling.

items.name: Obsidian Ring
items.lore: Black glass ground into a band and pinned with iron. It took the heat once and kept the shape.

items.name: Obsidian Pendant
items.lore: An obsidian flake knapped to a point and hung on iron. The edge is still the sharpest thing you own.

items.name: Bloodwood Log
items.lore: Cut it at noon and it is brown. Cut it when the moon is on the water and it is not.

items.name: Mirrorflax
items.lore: Retted in the lake and dried on the shore. Held up, a hank of it shows you the back of your own head.

items.name: Lunar Essence
items.lore: Something down there finished being the moon and this stayed.

items.name: Lunar Dust
items.lore: Cold, and it lies flat however you pour it.

items.name: Lunar Shard
items.lore: You can see the room in it, slightly further away than the room is.

items.name: Lunar Crystal
items.lore: It is cold, and it does not stop being cold.

items.name: Bloodwood Quarterstaff
items.lore: Heavy, dark, and warm to hold for no reason anyone has explained.

items.name: Bloodwood Wand
items.lore: A finger's length of heartwood and nothing else.

items.name: Bloodwood Knot
items.lore: Where a branch tried to leave and the tree said no.

items.name: Mirrorflax Hood
items.lore: Cut straight, sewn straight, and the brim is a dead level line on purpose.

items.name: Mirrorflax Robe
items.lore: Layered four deep. In still air it hangs like water.

items.name: Mirrorflax Leggings
items.lore: Quilted, because the shore is stone and the stone is cold.

items.name: Mirrorflax Boots
items.lore: Soft-soled. You will not hear yourself and neither will anything else.

items.name: Mirrorflax Gloves
items.lore: Palms doubled. The hand is the piece you put in the way.

items.name: The Waning Charm
items.lore: It was a full ring once. Everyone who has owned it says so and none of them can say when it stopped.

items.name: The Larger Reflection
items.lore: It fits. It has always fitted. In the water it is a size larger and it fits there too.

items.name: Orrery Scrap
items.lore: A tooth off a gear the size of a door. Whatever it was counting, it is one short now.

items.name: Arcsalt
items.lore: White crust where the machine has been earthing itself for four hundred years. It tastes like a held breath.

items.name: Sidereal Glass
items.lore: A lens out of a fallen ring. It still focuses. On what, nobody has stood in front of long enough to say.

items.name: Starbrass Ingot
items.lore: Remelted mechanism. It takes a finer thread than anything you could buy in Concordance.

items.name: Arcsalt Draught
items.lore: Sharp, metallic, and it makes your teeth ring. Whatever it is doing, it does it fast.

items.name: Sidereal Signet
items.lore: A seal for something that has not needed sealing in a long time. The face is a date.

items.name: The Running Count
items.lore: Put them on and you know what number it is on. You do not know what it is counting.

items.name: Sidereal Glass Ring
items.lore: A ring of fallen lens glass in a skysteel setting. Look through it and something far off is in focus.

items.name: Sidereal Glass Pendant
items.lore: Three lenses stacked in a skysteel tube on a chain. They line up only when you are about to need them to.

items.name: Ironwood Log
items.lore: It does not float, it turns a saw, and it has been standing here since before the water left.

items.name: Glasswort
items.lore: It holds one mouthful of water and gives it up bitter. Nobody who crosses here has ever said it tasted like anything but living.

items.name: Solar Essence
items.lore: What is left of the sun after something has finished being it.

items.name: Solar Dust
items.lore: Bright enough that you look at your hand and not at it.

items.name: Solar Shard
items.lore: Dust that held its shape long enough to cast a shadow.

items.name: Solar Crystal
items.lore: It is bright, and it does not stop being bright.

items.name: Pilgrim's Ration
items.lore: Salt, fat and flour, pressed into a brick and wrapped in cloth. It is not food so much as an argument that you are not dead.

items.name: Glasswort Draught
items.lore: Green, saline and shockingly cold in a place with no cold in it. Pilgrims drink it standing, because sitting down out here is how it starts.

items.name: Ironwood Quarterstaff
items.lore: Cut, cured and shod. It is heavier than it looks and it will be heavier still at the end of the day.

items.name: Ironwood Wand
items.lore: Short, light, and shaped to be pointed rather than swung.

items.name: Ironwood Knot
items.lore: A burl left whole, because the grain in a burl goes every way at once and that turns out to matter.

items.name: The Shadeless Band
items.lore: Worn by people who walked this in daylight on purpose. The inside is polished; the outside never has been.

items.name: The Hardest Edge
items.lore: Your shadow is the hardest-edged thing you have ever seen, and someone has put a handle on it.

items.name: Wrackcotton
items.lore: It grows on the flats and is only there for six hours a day. Everything about harvesting it is the clock.

items.name: Nacre
items.lore: Shell-lining, prised off in whole plates. Nobody in Concordance knows what to do with it yet. Someone at Rimeholt will.

items.name: Drownling Hide
items.lore: Off something the tide uncovered. It has never been dry and it is not wet.

items.name: Wrackcotton Hood
items.lore: Salt-stiffened and cut with a flat brim, the way everyone here cuts everything.

items.name: Wrackcotton Robe
items.lore: Six layers. It is the warmest thing on the shoals and it still takes an hour to dry.

items.name: Wrackcotton Leggings
items.lore: Quilted to the knee and plain below it, because below the knee is underwater twice a day.

items.name: Wrackcotton Boots
items.lore: High, soft and laced at the back so you can get out of them fast.

items.name: Wrackcotton Gloves
items.lore: Palms tripled. You put your hands out here, or the shoals put them out for you.

items.name: Drownling Belt
items.lore: Five loops of hide that has never taken a dye.

items.name: The Turning Tide
items.lore: It is heavy at the low and light at the high. Sailors swear that is the shell and not them.

items.name: Lowwater Tread
items.lore: Made for the six hours. Whoever wore them out here came back, which is more than most.

items.name: Sky-Iron Ore
items.lore: Iron that arrived rather than formed. It rusts differently and nobody local will say how.

items.name: Fallstone
items.lore: Whatever is at the bottom of each bowl. It weighs what it should and nothing else about it does.

items.name: Skysteel Ingot
items.lore: Smelted with charcoal, because nothing else here burns. It takes an edge that should not be possible.

items.name: Astral Essence
items.lore: The last of whatever was aiming.

items.name: Astral Dust
items.lore: It scatters, and then it is in a pattern.

items.name: Astral Shard
items.lore: Cold sparks with corners on them.

items.name: Astral Crystal
items.lore: It is far away, and holding it does not change that.

items.name: Zodiac Pendant
items.lore: Twelve marks around the rim, and the one at the top is not one of the twelve.

items.name: The Aimed Sky
items.lore: It is not a map of where things are. It is a map of where they are going.

items.name: Ebony Log
items.lore: Grown on the dark side. It sinks, it will not take a nail, and it polishes like stone.

items.name: Duskcap
items.lore: It fruits along the line where the light stops and nowhere else. Boiled, it is the best thing in the valley.

items.name: Eclipse Opal
items.lore: Light on one face, dark on the other, and the line between them does not move when you turn it.

items.name: Duskcap Tonic
items.lore: Drink it and count to three. Each count is worth something.

items.name: Ebony Quarterstaff
items.lore: It weighs what a bar of iron weighs and it is wood.

items.name: Ebony Wand
items.lore: A short black line that the eye keeps sliding off.

items.name: Ebony Knot
items.lore: The only pale thing on it is where it was cut.

items.name: Crestline Ring
items.lore: Worn on the hand you reach with. Half the band has been in the sun and half has not, and they do not match.

items.name: The Dividing Line
items.lore: Hold it up along the crest and it disappears.

items.name: Eclipse Opal Ring
items.lore: A skysteel band with an opal set flush, light side out. Turn it in and it is a plain ring.

items.name: Eclipse Opal Pendant
items.lore: Three opals on a skysteel bar, all turned the same way. The line between light and dark runs straight through every one.

items.name: Sunbleach Lichen
items.lore: It grows in the one strip the lenses never sweep. Dried and steeped, it is what the readers drank.

items.name: Aetherglass
items.lore: Archive glass, cut out of a roof. Held at the right angle it is still holding a word.

items.name: Palimpsest Vellum
items.lore: Scraped clean and written on again, and again. The first thing on it is still there and still legible if you stop trying.

items.name: Arcane Dust
items.lore: You are certain, afterwards, that you knew something.

items.name: Arcane Shard
items.lore: Dust that made up its mind.

items.name: Arcane Crystal
items.lore: It is known, and it does not stop being known.

items.name: Sunbleach Tonic
items.lore: Pale, bitter, and it works on the way down rather than all at once. The readers took it at dawn and finished the day.

items.name: Celestial Totem
items.lore: Three essences and a socket cut to hold all three. The guard above Rimeholt does not take it off you; he looks, and then he steps aside.

items.name: Palimpsest Belt
items.lore: Six loops of scraped hide. Someone's handwriting runs under the stitching and does not stop at the seam.

items.name: The Last Reading
items.lore: Whoever was here at the end took one page with them and it is this one.

items.name: The Noon Hour
items.lore: For about forty minutes a day it is the most useful object in the world. It is worn the other twenty-three hours anyway.

items.name: Deepstratum Ore
items.lore: Out of the lowest band the shaft reaches. It is older than iron has any business being.

items.name: Nadir Garnet
items.lore: Cut out of the bottom band. Held up, the flecks in it are a constellation and it is not one of ours.

items.name: Corebiter Hide
items.lore: Off the thing that eats downward. It has never seen light and it does not reflect any.

items.name: Deepsteel Ingot
items.lore: Smelted at Vespergate, because nowhere higher has fuel.

items.name: Corebiter Belt
items.lore: Seven loops of a hide that takes no dye and needs none.

items.name: Everice Band
items.lore: Ice that never warmed, set in a band by somebody who finally had the tools. It has been in a pack since Frostfell.

items.name: Nacre Pendant
items.lore: Shell off the Tidewrack flats, backed in black glass. Nobody at Concordance knew what it was for. Rimeholt did.

items.name: Stonefall Signet
items.lore: The face is blank. Whatever it sealed, the seal is what mattered.

items.name: Bedrock Greaves
items.lore: Plated in the stuff that was under everything. They are not comfortable and they have never once given.

items.name: Aetherwood Log
items.lore: Cut for a staircase that arrives somewhere nobody built. There is more of it than there was ever material for.

items.name: Mana Slag
items.lore: What ran out of the floor when the school stopped. It is still warm at the centre of the heap.

items.name: Aethersteel Ingot
items.lore: Smelted out of the spill. It rings for about four seconds longer than it should.

items.name: The Written Third
items.lore: It is warmer in the middle than at either end, and this is the middle.

items.name: Aetherwood Quarterstaff
items.lore: The last wood. There is nothing after this and the carvers know it.

items.name: Aetherwood Wand
items.lore: Short, squared, and it does not taper so much as stop.

items.name: Aetherwood Knot
items.lore: There should not be a burl in wood that was never a tree. There is.

items.name: Chalkline Signet
items.lore: The syllabus is still on the wall. This is the seal that approved it.

items.name: The Unbuilt Stair
items.lore: It arrives. What it arrives at was never built, and it arrives there anyway.

items.name: Censer Resin
items.lore: Scraped out of the censers along the warm stretch. They have not been lit in four hundred years and the resin is not cold.

items.name: Reliquary Gold
items.lore: Off the fittings. Soft, pure, and somebody had a great deal of it to spare on a corridor.

items.name: Unleft Linen
items.lore: Altar cloth. Still folded, still square, still on the altar. Nobody took it and nobody came back for it.

items.name: Censer Draught
items.lore: Red-gold, resinous, and it goes down warm. It is the only thing anyone has ever taken out of here that helped.

items.name: Unleft Linen Hood
items.lore: Cut from altar cloth by somebody who needed a hood more than they needed the argument.

items.name: Unleft Linen Robe
items.lore: Six layers of a cloth that was folded and left. It has never once been worn out of doors before now.

items.name: Unleft Linen Leggings
items.lore: Quilted through with the same cloth. It is warm, and nobody is coming to ask for it back.

items.name: Unleft Linen Boots
items.lore: Soft-soled, because the corridor is stone and the stone carries.

items.name: Unleft Linen Gloves
items.lore: Palms quadrupled. Whatever the second hand was doing down here, it did it with its hands.

items.name: Aetherglass Locket
items.lore: Archive glass, carried up the mountain, and finally set by somebody who could.

items.name: Censer Pendant
items.lore: Two hands made it. You can see where they disagreed.

items.name: The Unconsecrated
items.lore: Somebody walked the whole corridor in these and was not permitted, and walked it anyway.

items.name: Umbralweave
items.lore: It comes off the ice in sheets, and it is not ice. Pull it in the dark or it comes apart in your hands.

items.name: Thoughtglass
items.lore: Ice that has held one shape for longer than ice can. Cut it and the new face is the same shape.

items.name: Umbra Dust
items.lore: It does not settle so much as decide where to be.

items.name: Umbra Shard
items.lore: Dust with an opinion.

items.name: Umbra Crystal
items.lore: It is decided, and it does not stop being decided.

items.name: The Dark Third
items.lore: A third of something that was broken on purpose, into three, by someone who wanted all three carried a long way apart.

items.name: Umbralweave Hood
items.lore: The brim is straight because a straight brim is a line you can aim along in no light at all.

items.name: Umbralweave Robe
items.lore: Six layers of a cloth that gives nothing back. It is the warmest thing on the north face.

items.name: Umbralweave Leggings
items.lore: Quilted through. Nothing on this face has melted in living memory and neither will you.

items.name: Umbralweave Boots
items.lore: Soft, black, and the sole is cut so it does not print in the ice.

items.name: Umbralweave Gloves
items.lore: Palms tripled. Out here the thing you put in the way is your hand and then it is your whole arm.

items.name: The Considered Ring
items.lore: It was made to fit one finger and it fits every finger. Somebody thought about that.

items.name: The Deliberate Dark
items.lore: Not an absence. A decision, worn on the hand of whoever agrees with it.

items.name: Nightink
items.lore: It is being made somewhere and it is arriving here. Nobody has found the somewhere.

items.name: Colophon Stone
items.lore: The stone a book's last page is cut from. There are a great many of them here and every book is still being written.

items.name: Blankspine Vellum
items.lore: It has not been written on yet. That is the only difference between it and everything else here.

items.name: Nightink Draught
items.lore: Black, thick, and it tastes of nothing whatsoever. Vespergate brews it and will not say from what.

items.name: Blankspine Belt
items.lore: Nine loops of a vellum that has not been written on. You will want to keep it that way.

items.name: Colophon Signet
items.lore: It presses a mark that means 'ends here'. Nothing here ends.

items.name: The Open Colophon
items.lore: Held open at the last page. The last page is being written and it is about you.

items.name: Spiritwood Log
items.lore: It grew beside the road, which means someone planted it, which means someone expected to come back.

items.name: Goldenrood
items.lore: Yellow, waist-high, and it grows in the channel and nowhere else on the mountain. Somebody cut that channel.

items.name: Sanctus Dust
items.lore: Warm on the palm, and it stays where you put it.

items.name: Sanctus Shard
items.lore: Dust that was kept, and kept together.

items.name: Sanctus Crystal
items.lore: It is looked after, and it does not stop being looked after.

items.name: Climber's Ration
items.lore: Hard cheese, harder bread, and a strip of something salted. Rimeholt sells it by the week and nobody argues about the price.

items.name: Goldenrood Draught
items.lore: Gold, faintly sweet, and it works before you have finished swallowing. The markers on the road are the same colour.

items.name: The Kept Third
items.lore: The vow, kept. Whoever still walks this road was given a third of something to hold, and has held it.

items.name: Spiritwood Quarterstaff
items.lore: Cut from beside the road and shod at Rimeholt. It is lighter than it should be for how hard it hits.

items.name: Spiritwood Wand
items.lore: Short, pale, and it does not warm to the hand the way wood does.

items.name: Spiritwood Knot
items.lore: A burl off a tree somebody was tending. It is the only part they did not straighten.

items.name: Votive Pendant
items.lore: Left at a marker and taken by nobody for four hundred years, which is its own argument.

items.name: The Maintained Road
items.lore: Whoever is doing the upkeep has not been seen, has not been thanked, and has not stopped.

items.name: Worldroot
items.lore: Dug from under the wall, on the outside. Whatever is in there has been sending something out this whole time.

items.name: Orchard Amber
items.lore: Sap off a tree nobody has pruned in four hundred years, and it is still the right shape.

items.name: Thornpenitent Hide
items.lore: Off something that was let in and did not leave. The thorns grew through it rather than into it.

items.name: Worldroot Tonic
items.lore: Earthy, sweet at the back, and it keeps working. Three mouthfuls in one bottle and the bottle knows the order.

items.name: Thornpenitent Belt
items.lore: Eight loops. The thorns are on the inside, which whoever made it will have meant.

items.name: Eclipse Opal Signet
items.lore: Sunless Reach opal, cut at Rimeholt into the only shape that keeps the line.

items.name: Orchard Amber Loop
items.lore: Garden amber in a plain band. It is warm, and it does not stop being warm.

items.name: The Gardener's Loop
items.lore: Whoever was last in there took nothing and left this on the gatepost.

items.name: The Season At Once
items.lore: Inside, everything is in leaf and in season at once. Somebody wove that.

items.name: Eclipse Iron
items.lore: Off the thing in the door. It is cold in a way iron is not and it does not take a shine.

items.name: Corona Pearl
items.lore: The ring of light around a thing that is in the way. It came off the same thing.

items.name: Corona Pearl Torc
items.lore: A neck ring, open at the front, because a torc is a thing you are given rather than a thing you buy.

items.name: Eclipse Iron Ring
items.lore: Plain, black, and it is the last thing anybody in this world learned how to make.

items.name: The Eclipsed Band
items.lore: It has been between something and something else for a very long time.

items.name: The Last Thing in the Way
items.lore: It stopped everyone. Then it stopped.

items.name: The Corona
items.lore: You see it from below, all the way up the mountain, and you take it off the thing that was wearing it.

items.name: Aqua Core
items.lore: The weight of a lake, and it fits in one hand.

items.name: Aqua Heart
items.lore: Every tide that ever turned, turning once more in your palm.

items.name: Pyro Core
items.lore: The middle of a fire, kept after the fire was put out.

items.name: Pyro Heart
items.lore: It burns because it decided to, and it has not changed its mind.

items.name: Flora Core
items.lore: It has a pulse if you hold it long enough to doubt it.

items.name: Flora Heart
items.lore: It beats, slowly, in the season it was made.

items.name: Electro Core
items.lore: The moment before the strike, kept from ever arriving.

items.name: Electro Heart
items.lore: The storm is not around it. The storm is in it.

items.name: Aero Core
items.lore: A wind that found the middle of itself and stayed there.

items.name: Aero Heart
items.lore: It weighs nothing, and it will not be let go of.

items.name: Geo Core
items.lore: The part of the mountain the mountain stood on.

items.name: Geo Heart
items.lore: It does not move. Everything else is measured from it.

items.name: Solar Core
items.lore: Noon, folded small enough to carry.

items.name: Solar Heart
items.lore: It is daylight, and it does not set.

items.name: Lunar Core
items.lore: Whichever way you turn it, you are looking at the far side.

items.name: Lunar Heart
items.lore: Every phase of the moon at once, and none of them for you.

items.name: Astral Core
items.lore: A chart of the sky with one star on it, and this is the star.

items.name: Astral Heart
items.lore: It is very far away, and it is also here.

items.name: Sanctus Core
items.lore: It keeps a vigil, and you are inside it.

items.name: Sanctus Heart
items.lore: It forgives you for holding it.

items.name: Umbra Core
items.lore: The dark at the bottom of the dark, and it has edges.

items.name: Umbra Heart
items.lore: It is what the light was afraid of, and it is patient.

items.name: Arcane Core
items.lore: Everything it knows, and none of it said aloud.

items.name: Arcane Heart
items.lore: It is the answer, and it has forgotten the question.

items.name: Lesser Aqua Gem
items.lore: There is a tide in it, turning, if you look for it.

items.name: Standard Aqua Gem
items.lore: There is a tide in it, turning.

items.name: Greater Aqua Gem

gatherNodes.flavor: An old stand, wind-felled and seasoning where it lies. Good logs, if your arms are willing.
A tangle thick enough to trip a horse. The trick is cutting it before it notices.
It crowds the shallows where the light comes back off the stones. Cut at the waterline and the roots carry on without you.
The grit gives out on a seam the slope has been keeping to itself, rust-green and warm to the back of the hand. It comes away in flakes.
The mire rets its own flax and leaves it hanging in the current like hair. Draw it steadily; it comes free in lengths, or not at all.
It has been down there longer than the trees have. Follow it by feel; the water will not tell you where it stops.
A drowned trunk, black as tar, with something gold caught in the split of it. Whatever summer that was, the water kept it.
Pale trunks in ranks, every one of them the same age, straight enough to sight along. The vale grew them itself in the years since.
A green line drawn down the grey where a stream still runs. Cold in the hand, which is the first cold thing all day.
Snags burned through and still standing, black the whole way in. Take the char and leave the ash — nothing here needs burning twice.
A seam in a terrace wall the diggers left because it was not what they came for.
Red banding in a cut face, squarer than anything nature makes.
The only trees on the steppe, and every one of them leaning the same way.
A dip where the wind passes over rather than through.
The tideline's own rope, laid out and salt-cured by the weather. Draw it steadily and it comes free in lengths.
It grows where the spray reaches and nowhere the spray does not — a ledge you can find with your eyes shut, once you know the smell.
Grey-green scale on black rock, the only living colour in the pass.
Ice in the rock that the black walls have never warmed.
Mountain ash above the treeline, which should not be possible.
Rust-red rock that the storm has been finding for a very long time.
Quartz with a note in it. Strike it wrong and the note stops.
A glass front where the floor stopped being liquid, still sharp along every edge it broke on.
White crust at a vent's lip, where the heat leaves something behind on its way out.
They lean out over the water and the water shows them leaning back.
Retted where the lake does not move. Pull steadily or you pull it in two.
A fallen ring, still turning, and shedding teeth as it goes.
Where the machine has been putting its charge for four centuries. Scrape between the flashes.
A ring came down here and most of what it was made of is still edge-up.
Four trees in eleven miles, and every one of them older than the road.
The only green thing out here grows in the one place with no water at all.
Six hours of flat, and then it is not flat any more. Draw steadily along the grain or the whole bed comes up as mud.
A shell bed the water uncovers twice a day and has never once uncovered empty.
The bottom of a shallow bowl, and the thing in it did not come from the bowl.
Deeper than the others, with something at the bottom that weighs right and looks wrong.
Black trunks on black rock. You find them by walking into them.
They fruit along the line the light stops at, in a row, like something planted them.
Split it wrong and you get two dull halves. Split it right and you get the line.
The one strip of hillside the lenses never sweep, and the only thing alive on it.
Roof glass, off a roof. Let it cool too fast and you get sand.
Around midday the whole shelf is writing. Take a plate from where the writing is not.
The lowest band the shaft reaches, and the shaft was going somewhere.
A pocket of red in the black. Held to a lamp the flecks make a shape.
A staircase with more treads than it has height. Take one; there will be another.
What ran out of the floor when the school stopped, pooled in the vault below it.
The censers along the warm stretch. None of them has been lit and none is cold.
Somebody had a great deal of gold to spare on a corridor nobody was meant to walk.
Still folded, still square, still on the altar. Nobody took it.
It lifts off the ice in sheets if you pull it in the dark and tears if you do not.
Split it however you like. The new face comes out the same shape as the old one.
Round the shoulder, where the light stops and the sheets are thickest.
The well is full and nothing fills it. Draw steadily; it does not like haste.
Every book's last page is cut from one of these, and every book is still being written.
Planted in a row beside the road, which means somebody expected to come back.
It only grows in the cut channel, and the channel did not cut itself.
Where they got the stone for the road. It came from further down than the road is.
Dug from under the wall on the outside, where something inside has been reaching.
Sap on a bough nobody has pruned in four centuries, and the bough is still right.
Against the wall itself, where whatever is inside is pushing hardest.
